title: Hong Kong man found guilty of murdering yoga instructor ex-girlfriend in luxury hotel room
zh_title: 香港男子在豪华酒店房间谋杀瑜伽教练前女友被判有罪
summary: A Hong Kong man has been found guilty of murdering his ex-girlfriend, more than four years after she was found dead in a bathtub in a luxury hotel room.高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 Alex Lo, 32, was convicted at the High Court on Thursday, the 14th day of his trial, after the seven-member jury – comprising five men and two women – arrived at the unanimous verdict.他被指控于2022年6月29日至30日在西九龙丽思卡尔顿酒店谋杀瑜伽教练Aqua Chow。周去世时年仅23岁。她原计划飞往美国参加瑜伽训练
content:
A Hong Kong man has been found guilty of murdering his ex-girlfriend, more than four years after she was found dead in a bathtub in a luxury hotel room.高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 Alex Lo, 32, was convicted at the High Court on Thursday, the 14th day of his trial, after the seven-member jury – comprising five men and two women – arrived at the unanimous verdict.他被指控于2022年6月29日至30日在西九龙丽思卡尔顿酒店谋杀瑜伽教练Aqua Chow。周去世时年仅23岁。 2022 年 6 月 30 日，她的尸体在酒店浴缸中被发现，当时她原定飞往美国参加瑜伽培训课程。法庭在庭审中获悉，罗与周于 2021 年 2 月成为情侣，并于次年 1 月分手，但仍保持联系。 During the trial, Lo testified that he had run up enormous debt taking Chow to high-end restaurants and purchasing luxury items for her, saying he loved her very much.他说，债务让他产生了自杀念头，因为贷款公司追着他还钱。周阿夸.照片：yoga.aqua，来自 Instagram。 The prosecution suggested that Lo had brought the financial burden onto himself, and Judge Kwok Kai-on said his situation could have been prevented.
对于罗说他有自杀念头的说法，郭问这些想法是否仍然是“一个想法”。他认为罗并不“认真”，因为有两次，当他作证想要自杀时，他给与周分手后开始交往的新女友打电话。此外，在审讯期间，罗作证说，他于2022年6月29日在油麻地购买的34厘米刀，是为了在酒店房间自杀而准备的。但他说，在一次争吵中，周告诉他他不是她终止的两次怀孕的父亲，他愤怒地“头脑爆炸”。他说他眼前一黑，只记得冲向她并刺伤了她。根据香港法律，谋杀罪被判处无期徒刑。该案押后至周五宣判。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong man has been found guilty of murdering his ex-girlfriend, more than four years after she was found dead in a bathtub in a luxury hotel room. High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Alex Lo, 32, was convicted at the High Court on Thursday, the 14th day of his trial, after the seven-member jury – comprising five men and two women – arrived at the unanimous verdict. He had been charged with murdering yoga instructor Aqua Chow between June 29 and June 30, 2022, at the Ritz-Carlton in West Kowloon. Chow was 23 when she died. She had been scheduled to fly to the US for a yoga training course when her body was found in the hotel bathtub on June 30, 2022. The court heard during the trial that Lo and Chow became a couple in February 2021 and broke up the following January, although they stayed in touch. During the trial, Lo testified that he had run up enormous debt taking Chow to high-end restaurants and purchasing luxury items for her, saying he loved her very much. The debt left him suicidal, he said, as loan companies chased him to repay the money. Aqua Chow. Photo: yoga.aqua, via Instagram. The prosecution suggested that Lo had brought the financial burden onto himself, and Judge Kwok Kai-on said his situation could have been prevented. Regarding Lo’s statements that he felt suicidal, Kwok asked whether those thoughts remained “an idea.” He suggested Lo was not “serious” because on two occasions when he testified to wanting to take his own life, he had phoned his new girlfriend whom he began seeing after breaking up with Chow. Also during the trial, Lo testified that the 34-centimetre knife he bought in Yau Ma Tei on June 29, 2022, was meant for killing himself in the hotel room. But he said that amid an argument, in which Chow told him he was not the father of the two pregnancies she had terminated, his “mind exploded” in fury. He said he blacked out, and that all he remembered was charging towards her and stabbing her. Under Hong Kong law, murder carries a mandatory life term. The case was adjourned to Friday for the sentence to be handed down.

title: Trump says summit with Xi, Putin ‘making history’
zh_title: 特朗普称与习近平、普京的峰会“创造历史”
summary: The presidents of China, the United States and Russia held an unprecedented summit in China on Thursday, with Donald Trump saying the three men were “making history”. China’s President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russia’s President Vladimir Putin arrive for a trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong province, on November 19, 2026. Photo: Win McNamee/AFP.特朗普、习近平和普京在深圳麒麟山庄的闭门会晤结束后
content:
中国、美国和俄罗斯总统周四在中国举行了前所未有的峰会，唐纳德·特朗普称这三人正在“创造历史”。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会期间，中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京抵达麒麟山庄举行三边会议。照片：Win McNamee/法新社。特朗普、习近平和普京在深圳麒麟山庄的闭门会晤在1小时20分钟后结束。会议一开始，三人围坐在一张深色的大圆桌旁，围绕从核武器到乌克兰战争等重大话题发表了开场白，圆桌中央摆放着粉红色的插花。特朗普表示：“我很高兴这次访问也为我们提供了举行美国、俄罗斯和中国领导人首次三边会晤的机会。” “所以从这个意义上说，我认为在很多其他方面，我们确实在创造历史，”他补充道。分析人士预计，此次峰会的象征意义大于突破性进展，恰逢俄罗斯对乌克兰的攻势已接近五年大关，并引发了世界各地的恐慌和嘲笑。香港深水埗的一个摊位上展示着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京等人的面孔的磁铁。
Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.Xi told his counterparts that the three countries should “jointly safeguard world peace and stability”, while Putin said they had a shared interest to resolve the Ukraine war. “Our countries have many converging interests when it comes to resolving regional conflicts, including, of course, the conflict in Ukraine,” Putin said, adding they had a “shared responsibility for maintaining international peace and security”. He said the closed-door discussions would also touch on food and energy security — both of which have been upended by conflicts in Iran and Ukraine. Trump is bogged down by his war with Iran that has choked oil supplies and pushed up consumer prices worldwide, while an ascendant China is looking to strengthen its hand in East Asia. ‘Nice to meet you’ The Kylin Villa summit has stoked fears that the three powerful men want to divide the globe into spheres of influence, for example by making decisions impacting Ukraine over the heads of Kyiv or Europe. Earlier Thursday, Trump and Putin held a meeting — their first since August 2025 — with the 80-year-old US president calling the Russian his “friend”, who responded in English: “Nice to meet you.” Trump and Xi then came together — for the third time this year — for one-on-one discussions, with the US leader highlighting their “very special relationship”. 2026 年 5 月 15 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在北京中南海合影留念。
照片：白宫，来自 Flickr. 中国国家主席称，74 岁的普京和 73 岁的习近平周三举行了会谈，这是他们的第 50 次会面。北京、华盛顿和莫斯科对亚太经合组织(APEC)论坛期间三方会议的议程给出了不同的描述。在特朗普表示战争将成为焦点之前，华盛顿最初表示不考虑乌克兰问题。习近平并不认为这场冲突是中国需要解决的问题。特朗普在与习近平会面时表示，中巴两国

【原文 English Original】
The presidents of China, the United States and Russia held an unprecedented summit in China on Thursday, with Donald Trump saying the three men were “making history”. China’s President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russia’s President Vladimir Putin arrive for a trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong province, on November 19, 2026. Photo: Win McNamee/AFP. The meeting behind closed doors between Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Kylin Villa in Shenzhen ended after an hour and 20 minutes. At the start the three men made opening remarks touching on weighty topics from nuclear weapons to the war in Ukraine as they met around a large, dark round table with a pink flower arrangement at its centre. “I’m delighted that this trip has also given us the opportunity for this first ever trilateral meeting between the leaders of the United States, Russia and China,” Trump said. “So in that sense, and I think in lots of other ways, we are really making history,” he added. The summit, which analysts expect to be heavier in symbolism than breakthroughs, comes with Russia’s Ukraine offensive approaching the five-year mark, and has sparked both alarm and derision around the world. Magnets showing faces of US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, alongside others, are displayed at a stall in Sham Shui Po, Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Xi told his counterparts that the three countries should “jointly safeguard world peace and stability”, while Putin said they had a shared interest to resolve the Ukraine war. “Our countries have many converging interests when it comes to resolving regional conflicts, including, of course, the conflict in Ukraine,” Putin said, adding they had a “shared responsibility for maintaining international peace and security”. He said the closed-door discussions would also touch on food and energy security — both of which have been upended by conflicts in Iran and Ukraine. Trump is bogged down by his war with Iran that has choked oil supplies and pushed up consumer prices worldwide, while an ascendant China is looking to strengthen its hand in East Asia. ‘Nice to meet you’ The Kylin Villa summit has stoked fears that the three powerful men want to divide the globe into spheres of influence, for example by making decisions impacting Ukraine over the heads of Kyiv or Europe. Earlier Thursday, Trump and Putin held a meeting — their first since August 2025 — with the 80-year-old US president calling the Russian his “friend”, who responded in English: “Nice to meet you.” Trump and Xi then came together — for the third time this year — for one-on-one discussions, with the US leader highlighting their “very special relationship”. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping pose for a photo at Zhongnanhai in Beijing on May 15, 2026. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Putin, 74, and Xi, 73, held talks on Wednesday — their 50th meeting, the Chinese president said. Beijing, Washington and Moscow have given different accounts of the agenda for the three-way meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum. Washington initially signalled that Ukraine was off the table, before Trump said the war would feature. Xi does not view the conflict as China’s problem to solve. Trump said in his meeting with Xi however that both China and the United States were “looking to both help with respect to the war with Russia and Ukraine”. China said before that the trio will hold “in-depth exchanges on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations”. Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky (right) visits Bucha in April 2022, after the Russian invasion. Photo: Oleksandr Ratushniak. Critics warned that the optics from the meeting will be damaging for the US president — but a fillip to Xi and Putin. The meeting “gives Putin a platform to legitimise his war of aggression over Ukraine with seemingly little repercussions,” said Lyle Morris at the Asia Society Policy Institute. “Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are playing Donald Trump like a cheap violin,” Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer said. Nuclear disarmament Washington had also flagged up the Iran war and nuclear disarmament as topics of discussion, after a US-Russia bilateral treaty on atomic weapons expired in February. Beijing has long maintained that the United States and Russia must reduce their giant nuclear arsenals before it agrees to talks on its smaller stockpile. China’s nuclear arsenal. Photo: CCTV screenshot. “As the world’s three largest nuclear powers by far, the United States, Russia and China are uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth and also to lessen the risk that those weapons will ever be used,” Trump said. Airport welcome Thursday’s extraordinary meeting preceded equally unusual scenes as the leaders arrived in the southern Chinese city for the talks. Breaking with decades of diplomatic protocol, Xi received Trump at the airport, with the men briefly hugging before a red-carpet greeting complete with cheering children and an air force flyover. This reciprocated the airport greeting Trump gave Xi at Joint Base Andrews in September. “It’s a friendship relationship. It’s a respect relationship,” Trump told Fox News. Takaichi, on her first visit since angering Beijing a year ago with comments about Taiwan, met Putin — relations are also tense — on Wednesday, Tokyo said. Takaichi said Thursday she wanted a “constructive and stable relationship” with China, but Japanese media said she did not manage to get a one-to-one meeting with Xi in Shenzhen. Despite their differences, all the leaders — including Putin — posed for the APEC “family photo” on Thursday in special scarves.

title: Hong Kong police arrest five over illegal drone flights during Shenzhen APEC summit
zh_title: 香港警方在深圳APEC峰会期间逮捕五名非法无人机飞行者
summary: 在世界领导人齐聚邻近的中国城市深圳参加亚太经济合作组织峰会之际，香港警方因非法无人机操作逮捕了五人。 2026年11月17日至19日，香港警方在深圳举办亚太经合组织峰会期间逮捕了五名未经许可操作无人机的人。照片：警察。警方周四表示，两名年龄分别为 27 岁和 65 岁的男子分别在上水凤皇岭村和粉岭乐明街被捕，罪名是涉嫌在禁飞区操作无人机和非法飞行。
content:
在世界领导人齐聚邻近的中国城市深圳参加亚太经济合作组织峰会之际，香港警方因非法无人机操作逮捕了五人。 2026年11月17日至19日，香港警方在深圳举办亚太经合组织峰会期间逮捕了五名未经许可操作无人机的人。照片：警察。警方周四表示，两名年龄分别为 27 岁和 65 岁的男子分别在上水凤凰岭村和粉岭乐明街被捕，罪名是涉嫌在禁飞区内操作无人机以及违反飞机相关规定。警方在脸书上发帖称，周四午夜，另一名 20 岁男子因驾驶无人机在流浮山被捕。警方早些时候表示，周二，又有两名男子因操作无人机而分别在南生围和天水围被捕，分别为 40 岁和 67 岁。警方表示，警方在逮捕过程中缴获了无人机，并补充说刑事调查部门正在调查这些案件。香港警方于2026年11月17日至19日期间逮捕了五人，罪名是在深圳举行亚太经合组织峰会期间未经许可操作无人机。照片：警察。由于邻近的深圳主办亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会，香港当局在周五之前实施了为期四天的禁飞区，禁止未经授权的无人机飞越该市北部空域的大部分地区。
包括中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在内的世界领导人齐聚中国南方科技中心。习近平、特朗普和普京周四举行了历史性的三边会议。警方敦促居民在周四闭幕的亚太经合组织峰会期间操作无人机之前，先查看政府有关禁飞区的通知。根据《小型无人机令》，未经许可在飞行限制区内操作无人机即属犯罪，最高可被处以罚款 10 万港元及监禁两年。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong police have arrested five people over illegal drone operations as world leaders gather in the neighbouring Chinese city of Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Hong Kong police arrested five people between November 17 and 19, 2026, for operating drones without a permit as Shenzhen holds the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Photo: Police. Police said on Thursday that two men, aged 27 and 65, were arrested in Sheung Shui’s Fung Wong Leng Estate and Fanling’s Lok Ming Street, respectively, for allegedly operating drones within restricted flight areas and violating aircraft-related rules. Another man, aged 20, was arrested in Lau Fau Shan at midnight on Thursday for flying a drone, police said in a Facebook post. Two more men, aged 40 and 67, were apprehended in Nam Sang Wai and Tin Shui Wai, respectively, on Tuesday over operating drones, police said earlier. Officers seized the drones during the arrests, police said, adding that the cases were being investigated by criminal investigation units. Hong Kong police have arrested five people between November 17 and 19, 2026, for operating drones without a permit as Shenzhen holds the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Photo: Police. Hong Kong authorities have imposed a four-day restricted flying zone through Friday as neighbouring Shenzhen hosts the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, banning unauthorised drone flights across much of the city’s northern airspace. World leaders, including Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, have gathered in the southern Chinese tech hub. Xi, Trump and Putin held a historic trilateral meeting on Thursday. Police urged residents to check for government notices regarding the restricted flying zone before operating drones during the APEC summit, which closed on Thursday. Under the Small Unmanned Aircraft Order, operating a drone without permission within a restricted flying zone is an offence carrying a maximum penalty of a HK$100,000 fine and two years’ imprisonment.

title: Hong Kong sexual violence NGO flags ‘crucial room for improvement’ in sex crimes law overhaul
zh_title: 香港性暴力非政府组织指出性犯罪法改革有“重要的改进空间”
summary: A sexual violence NGO has said that concerns remain over the Hong Kong government’s proposal to overhaul the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws, including over a provision allowing defendants to claim they mistakenly believed they were given consent.香港的性犯罪法已经数十年没有更新，而该市也出现了各种新型性侵犯。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 In a Thursday statement , the Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women outlined its five key concerns over the bill, which was published in the government gazette last Friday ahead of l
content:
一家性暴力非政府组织表示，香港政府提议彻底修改该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律，其中包括一项允许被告声称他们错误地认为自己得到了同意的条款，这一提议仍然令人担忧。香港的性犯罪法已经数十年没有更新，而该市也出现了各种新型性侵犯。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在周四的一份声明中，针对妇女的性暴力协会概述了对该法案的五个主要担忧，该法案于上周五在本月底进行立法审查之前在政府公报上发布。该协会表示：“虽然我们赞赏该法案纳入了我们的几项建议，包括引入针对持续性儿童性虐待的新罪行，但仍存在重要的改进空间，以确保改革真正反映和改善受害者幸存者的生活现实。” The Sexual Offences Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 was first put forward this July.安全局表示，改革旨在审查该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律并使其更新，“以解决现行规定的不足之处，并应对与性犯罪有关的社会观念的变化”。担忧依然存在 在此次改革中，该非政府组织敦促政府纳入禁止被告在特定情况下声称“错误相信”同意的条款。
该协会列出了被告不能援引该辩护的11种情况——例如，受害者因中毒而失去知觉，因此无法表示同意。该协会表示，如果受害者受到暴力威胁或欺骗，也应被视为无法表示同意。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。它补充说，法院还应该通过考虑“被告为确定同意而实际所说或所做的事情”来确定错误信念是否合理。该非政府组织还表示，拟议的强奸罪应进行修改，以涵盖所有形式的口交性侵犯，“例如用嘴或舌头接触生殖器或肛门”，以确保法律对所有形式的口交性侵犯提供“平等的威慑和保护”。目前的法律草案仅涵盖一种形式的口交：用阴茎插入口腔。
该非政府组织表示，该法案还应将强奸罪重新命名为“未经同意的性侵”：“保留的术语‘强奸’——尤其是其中文对应词‘强奸’——带有严重的性别耻辱，阻碍了许多受害者幸存者寻求帮助。”该协会还建议强化持续性儿童性虐待罪，明确其追溯效力，并将事件门槛从法案中提出的三项行为降低至两项。该协会表示：“为了真正解决幸存者在回忆每起事件的具体细节方面所面临的困难，政府应借鉴其他司法管辖区的改革经验，将门槛提高到两项行为。”

【原文 English Original】
A sexual violence NGO has said that concerns remain over the Hong Kong government’s proposal to overhaul the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws, including over a provision allowing defendants to claim they mistakenly believed they were given consent. Hong Kong’s sexual offence laws have not been updated for dozens of years while the city saw various new types of sexual assault. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In a Thursday statement , the Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women outlined its five key concerns over the bill, which was published in the government gazette last Friday ahead of legislative scrutiny towards the end of the month. “While we appreciate that the Bill incorporates several of our recommendations, including the introduction of new offences addressing persistent child sexual abuse, there remains crucial room for improvement to ensure the reforms genuinely reflect and improve the lived realities of victim-survivors,” the association said. The Sexual Offences Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 was first put forward this July. The reforms aim to review the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws and bring them up to date, “to address the inadequacies of the current provisions and respond to changes in social perceptions related to sexual offences,” according to the Security Bureau. Concerns remain Under the overhaul, the NGO urged the government to include provisions barring a defendant from claiming a “mistaken belief” in consent under specific circumstances. The association listed 11 circumstances under which the accused should not be able to invoke that defence — for instance, where a victim was unconscious due to intoxication and therefore incapable of giving consent. Victims should also be considered incapable of giving consent if they were threatened with violence or deceived, the association said. Booklets published by Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women on sexual assault and sexual law reform. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The court should also determine whether a mistaken belief was reasonable by considering “what the accused actually said or did to ascertain consent,” it added. The NGO also said that the proposed rape offence should be amended to cover all forms of oral sexual assault “such as the application of the mouth or tongue to the genitalia or anus” to ensure that the law provides “equal deterrence and protection” against all forms of oral sexual assault. The draft law in its current form only covers one form of oral sexual assault: penetration of the mouth with the penis. The bill should also rename the rape offence to “sexual penetration without consent,” the NGO said: “The retained term ‘rape’ — and particularly its Chinese equivalent,「強姦」— carries a severe, gendered stigma that deters many victim-survivors from seeking help.” The association also suggested strengthening the persistent child sexual abuse offence by clarifying its retrospective effect and lowering the threshold of incidents from the three acts proposed in the bill to two. “To genuinely accommodate the difficulties survivors face in recalling the precise details of every single incident, the government should learn from the reform experiences from other jurisdictions and improve the threshold to two acts,” it said.

title: China’s Xi to host historic summit with Trump, Putin
zh_title: 中国习近平将与特朗普、普京举行历史性峰会
summary: 周四，中国、美国和俄罗斯总统在首次三边峰会前与其他亚太领导人合影留念，北京称这次峰会是关于“世界和平”的会谈。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会上，中国国家主席习近平（右）和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（左）在领导人合影前合影。照片：Greg Baker/法新社。习近平、特朗普和普京在深圳麒麟山庄举行三方会晤
content:
周四，中国、美国和俄罗斯总统在首次三边峰会前与其他亚太领导人合影留念，北京称这次峰会是关于“世界和平”的会谈。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会上，中国国家主席习近平（右）和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（左）在领导人合影前合影。照片：Greg Baker/法新社。习近平、特朗普和普京在深圳麒麟山庄举行三方会晤之际，俄罗斯对乌克兰的血腥攻势已接近五年。因中期选举失败而受伤的特朗普又因与伊朗的战争而陷入困境，而崛起的中国正在寻求加强其在东亚的影响力。这次秘密会议引发了人们的担忧，担心这三位有权势的人可能会寻求将全球划分为势力范围，例如将乌克兰的命运凌驾于基辅或欧洲之上。此前，特朗普和习近平将举行双边讨论，预计将讨论贸易关系以及英伟达间谍丑闻笼罩下的人工智能潜在共同规则。北京、华盛顿和莫斯科对亚太经合组织(APEC)论坛期间的会议内容给出了不同的描述。在特朗普表示战争将成为焦点之前，华盛顿最初表示不考虑乌克兰问题。
习近平并不认为这场冲突是中国需要解决的问题。克里姆林宫表示，议程尚未最终确定，但在会议上很难避免讨论乌克兰问题，会议预计将持续“不超过一个小时”。 2026 年 5 月 20 日，孩子们在北京人民大会堂举行的欢迎仪式上向中国国家主席习近平（左）和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京致意。照片：克里姆林宫。自 2022 年发动全面进攻以来，普京在很大程度上受到西方大国的回避，他在周三的亚太经合组织会议上表示，西方对其国家的制裁“失败了”。 “在军事政治风险上升之际，迫切需要的是……对话而不是最后通牒，”他说。中国仅表示，三方将“就维护世界和平、促进大国关系战略稳定进行深入交流”。批评者警告说，这次会议的景象将对美国总统造成损害。参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默表示：“习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京就像演奏廉价小提琴一样演奏唐纳德·特朗普。”盛大的欢迎 根据华盛顿的说法，在美俄双边原子武器条约二月份到期后，伊朗战争和核裁军问题也将成为讨论的焦点。然而，北京长期以来一直坚持认为，美国和俄罗斯应该先削减其庞大的核武库，然后才同意就其较小的核武库进行谈判。 “看，我们有 4000 件核武器。
俄罗斯拥有 3,800 枚核武器。中国现在有四五百枚，但他们会赶上的。你知道，在十年的时间里，他们正在行动。”特朗普告诉福克斯新闻。特朗普表示，他还考虑与普京以及朝鲜领导人金正恩进行一对一会谈，尽管后者没有出席会议。朝鲜领导人金正恩（左）和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（右）。照片：白宫/Flickr。习近平在

【原文 English Original】
The presidents of China, the United States and Russia posed for a photo with other Asia-Pacific leaders on Thursday ahead of their first ever trilateral summit, billed by Beijing as talks about “world peace”. China’s President Xi Jinping (R) and US President Donald Trump (L) pose for a photo before leaders take a group photo during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong Province, on November 19, 2026. Photo: Greg Baker/AFP. The three-way meeting between Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin at the Kylin Villa in Shenzhen comes with Russia’s bloody offensive in Ukraine approaching the five-year mark. Trump, wounded by the midterm election debacle, is bogged down by his war with Iran, and an ascendant China is looking to strengthen its hand in East Asia. The conclave has stoked fears that the three powerful men may seek to divide the globe into spheres of influence, for example deciding the fate of Ukraine over the heads of Kyiv or Europe. Beforehand Trump and Xi were due to hold bilateral discussions expected to touch on trade ties and potentially common rules for AI under the cloud of the Nvidia spy scandal . Beijing, Washington and Moscow have given different accounts of what they expect to discuss from the powwow on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum. Washington initially signalled that Ukraine was off the table, before Trump said the war would feature. Xi does not view the conflict as China’s problem to solve. The Kremlin has said that the agenda had not been finalised, but it would be hard to avoid discussing Ukraine at the meeting, which is set to last “no more than an hour”. Children greet Chinese President Xi Jinping (left) and Russian President Vladimir Putin during the welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on May 20, 2026. Photo: The Kremlin. Putin, largely shunned by Western powers since his 2022 full-scale offensive, told the APEC gathering on Wednesday that Western sanctions on his country had “failed”. “At a time when military-political risks are on the rise, what is desperately needed is… dialogue rather than ultimatums,” he said. China has said only that the trio will hold “in-depth exchanges on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations”. Critics warned that the optics from the meeting will be damaging for the US president. “Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are playing Donald Trump like a cheap violin,” Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer said. Lavish welcome Also up for discussion are the Iran war and nuclear disarmament, according to Washington, after a US-Russia bilateral treaty on atomic weapons expired in February. However, Beijing has long maintained that the United States and Russia should reduce their giant nuclear arsenals before it agrees to talks on its smaller stockpile. “Look, we have 4,000 nuclear weapons. Russia has 3,800 nuclear weapons. China now has four or five hundred, but they’re going to catch (up). You know, over a 10-year period, they’re moving,” Trump told Fox News. Trump has said he is also eyeing one-on-one talks with Putin as well as North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, though the latter is not present at the conference. North Korean Leader Kim Jong-un (left) and US President Donald Trump (right). Photo: The White House/Flickr. In a sign of the importance that China is placing on the trilateral summit, Xi gave Trump an extravagant welcome on Wednesday. Breaking with decades of diplomatic protocol, the Chinese leader personally received Trump at the airport, with the men briefly hugging before a red-carpet greeting complete with cheering children and an air-force flyover. It was the first time that China’s paramount leader had welcomed a foreign dignitary in person for decades, and reciprocated the airport greeting Trump gave Xi at Joint Base Andrews in September. “It’s a friendship relationship. It’s a respect relationship,” Trump told Fox News from Shenzhen. Xi “has never gone to the airport to meet somebody… It was a great respect, and I appreciate that. That’s a big win for us. It’s a big win for China too,” Trump said. ‘Serene authority’ “I look forward to an in-depth exchange of views with you on major issues concerning China-US relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation, and the global landscape, with the aim of advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship between our two nations,” Xi told Trump, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua. In contrast, Putin was welcomed at the airport by Cai Qi, China’s fifth-ranked leader, in accordance with regular protocol. Other world leaders at the APEC meeting include Japan’s Sanae Takaichi, South Korea’s Lee Jae Myung, Canada’s Mark Carney and Australia’s Anthony Albanese. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi (left) and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit in Gyeongju, South Korea, on October 31, 2025. Photo: Sanae Takaichi, via X. Takaichi, on her first visit to China since angering Beijing a year ago with comments about Taiwan, met Putin — with whom relations are also tense — on Wednesday, Tokyo said. Despite their differences, all the leaders — including Putin — posed for the APEC “family photo” on Thursday in matching scarves. Apart from the centrepiece trilateral, the group was also expected to discuss a range of other topics, including trade policy and artificial intelligence. Xi opened the APEC leaders’ meeting on Thursday with a call to “reduce barriers to trade and investment”. Analysts believe the day’s events will be heavily scripted, but underline that the personalities may yet spring surprises. “Typically, when Chinese leaders host meetings, every detail is nailed down and China’s leader is positioned to project an air of serene authority and control,” said Ryan Hass at the Brookings Institution. “Given the other leaders involved though — Trump and Putin — there is only so much choreography that can be done to eliminate unexpected moments,” Hass told AFP.

title: The Jet That Always Shadows Air Force One When The President Travels Abroad
zh_title: 当总统出国旅行时，这架喷气式飞机总是尾随空军一号
