【原文 English Original】
Copper slumped again on Friday, tipping the metal into a bear market just ten weeks after it set an all-time high, as the unwinding of bets on the artificial intelligence boom, a strong dollar and fading US tariff prospects continued to swamp evidence of acute shortage in China. Comex copper for December delivery, the most active contract in New York, dropped as much as 3.4% to $5.4405 a pound ($11,994 a tonne), the lowest since the end of March, before recovering to $5.4995 around midday, down 2.4%. That is 20.2% below the record settlement of $6.8885 reached on September 9. A close under $5.51 would meet the common definition of a bear market, a fall of 20% or more from the most recent peak. The contract has fallen for seven sessions in a row and is down more than 9% since last Friday, by far its steepest weekly loss of 2026. A year-to-date gain that stood at 22% in September has turned into a loss of 2%, and copper is on course to end November about 15% lower. On the London Metal Exchange, three-month copper fell 2.3% to $12,235 a tonne in official trading after touching $12,020, the lowest since March 24, Reuters reports. The benchmark is down about 9% on the week, its biggest weekly fall since early April 2025, when US President Donald Trump unveiled his global tariffs. London copper is 18% below its September 10 peak of $14,875 and would have to drop under $11,900 to join New York in a bear market. In Shanghai, futures racked up their worst week in 15 years, according to Bloomberg. Next stop, the March low The break below $5.63, where copper ended 2025, removes the first of two chart supports that Saxo Bank’s Ole Hansen flagged during Wednesday’s rout . The second is $5.32, which sits just beneath the lowest close of 2026: $5.34 on March 20, when surging oil prices during the Iran war and swelling exchange inventories sent the metal to a three-month trough. Copper is now less than 3% above that level. Evidence is mounting that the AI investment boom is waning and that the Federal Reserve will have to get more aggressive to control inflation, Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com, told Reuters, adding that a strengthening dollar is also weighing on the metal. AI shares continued to sag on Friday, with Anthropic trading about 9% below Thursday’s close after its market debut, the news agency said. “We have been saying for as long as AI has been driving the price that this might be a bit over-egged,” Albert Mackenzie, copper analyst at Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, told Bloomberg. Weak Chinese demand, the dimming prospect of US tariffs and the dollar are also at work, and the week’s losses are not far off the slumps seen in the early stages of the pandemic and after Trump’s Liberation Day announcement. London copper is heading for its steepest monthly decline since 2022 . Metal heads to China The selloff in futures is still running alongside a scramble for physical metal in China. The Yangshan premium paid to import copper into the country slipped to $495 a tonne on Friday from Thursday’s record $500, Reuters reports. It was $360 on Wednesday and less than $100 in September. Shanghai Futures Exchange stocks rose by 3,204 tonnes this week to 30,846 tonnes, which is still less than a day’s worth of Chinese consumption. That tightness may be part of what is pushing futures down. Premiums at these levels have made it profitable to move metal out of the United States, where stockpiles ballooned over the past year on tariff bets, and traders have begun shipping copper from the US to China , with tens of thousands of tonnes due to arrive in January. Codelco is meanwhile offering Chinese buyers 2027 cathode at $250 to $280 a tonne , less than it charged this year. The flow looks set to continue. China’s refined copper imports are poised to climb in 2027 after a rare drop this year, according to a Reuters poll of 15 analysts and traders, because shortages of concentrate and scrap are holding back domestic smelter output while demand keeps growing. Imports fell 16% to 2.37 million tonnes in the first ten months of 2026, the lowest for the period since at least 2015. “The gravitational pull of refined copper is now towards China,” said Nicholas Snowdon, head of metals and mining research at Mercuria, although Argus expects a moderate recovery rather than a surge. In London the squeeze has eased: cash copper was at only a slight premium to the three-month contract on Friday after flipping into a discount earlier in the week. $127 billion in a week Copper stocks were sold again in New York. Eleven of the largest copper-exposed miners have lost a combined $127 billion, or 15% of their market value, since last Friday, and $208 billion, or 23%, over the past month. Their combined worth has dropped to $696 billion from $769 billion on Wednesday morning. Freeport-McMoRan fell another 5.4%, taking its loss for the week to 22% and cutting its market value to $67 billion, from close to $100 billion a month ago. Southern Copper gave up 4.3% to $116 billion and has shed 32% in a month, a slide that has pushed the stock into the red for 2026 after it was up 41% in mid-October. BHP was little changed at $177 billion but is down 14% on the week, and Rio Tinto eased 1.3% to $127 billion. Glencore, at $71 billion, has lost a fifth of its value in a month. Teck Resources dropped 3.6% to $24 billion, Antofagasta 4.8% and First Quantum Minerals 3.7%, and Lundin Mining’s 2.3% decline left it 19% lower since last Friday. Only BHP, Glencore, Teck and Anglo American are still showing gains for the year, and Anglo’s is down to 1%. Ivanhoe Mines has lost 60% in 2026. (With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

title: Ground View Pakistan: The smelter before the mine
zh_title: 巴基斯坦地面景观：矿井前的冶炼厂
summary: 在全球精炼能力已经超过现有精矿供应的情况下，巴基斯坦建立国内铜加工业的雄心可能会让冶炼厂领先于矿山。总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫在伊斯兰堡举行的巴基斯坦矿产投资论坛 (PMIF) 上强调了这一雄心，承诺结束未加工矿物的出口，并呼吁西南部的雷科迪克项目和其他项目支持炼油厂、冶炼厂以及生产电缆和导体的工厂。 “在巴基斯坦开采，在巴基斯坦加工，在巴基斯坦制造，然后出口到世界其他地区
content:
在全球精炼能力已经超过现有精矿供应的情况下，巴基斯坦建立国内铜加工业的雄心可能会让冶炼厂领先于矿山。总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫在伊斯兰堡举行的巴基斯坦矿产投资论坛 (PMIF) 上强调了这一雄心，承诺结束未加工矿物的出口，并呼吁西南部的雷科迪克项目和其他项目支持炼油厂、冶炼厂以及生产电缆和导体的工厂。谢里夫说：“在巴基斯坦开采，在巴基斯坦加工，在巴基斯坦制造，然后出口到世界其他地区。”这一举措反映出巴基斯坦希望从矿产财富中获取更多就业机会、技能和出口收入。但由于只有山达克 (Saindak) 一家铜矿生产厂，其旗舰 Reko Diq 项目仍在等待商业生产，该国面临着更紧迫的挑战：在投入数十亿美元建设加工基础设施之前建立可靠的矿山产出。巴基斯坦联邦规划、发展和特别倡议部长阿赫桑·伊克巴尔表示，政府现在要求投资者提交完整的价值链提案，而不是仅仅关注开采和原材料出口的计划。这一要求给探险家带来了特殊的挑战。铜冶炼厂是围绕特定精矿设计的，包括其品位、杂质和预期产量。
如果没有明确的矿产资源和可靠的生产，开发商就无法做出贷款人要求的原料承诺。Milbank 律师事务所能源和基础设施合伙人穆尼布·侯赛因 (Munib Hussain) 表示，合同原料是此类项目融资的主要要求之一。区别很重要。 2025 年 4 月，我认为仅靠采矿并不能实现关键的矿产独立性，因此应优先考虑对加工的投资。这一论点涉及美国，美国现有的矿藏和数十年的生产为下游投资奠定了基础。巴基斯坦正处于早期阶段，全球铜市场呈现出不同的经济现实。冶炼经济 随着中国的新设施与印度、中亚和非洲不断扩大的业务展开竞争，铜冶炼厂正面临产能过剩的困境。处理和精炼费用方面的压力显而易见，矿工向冶炼厂支付费用，将精矿转化为精炼金属。安托法加斯塔和中国冶炼厂同意 2026 年基准为每吨 0 美元和每磅 0 美分，低于 2025 年每吨 21.25 美元和前一年的 80 美元。现货费用已降至零以下，标准普尔全球普氏能源资讯 (S&P Global Platts) 1 月份的评估值为每吨负 47.40 美元。这些负费用意味着加工商实际上正在向矿工支付费用以确保精矿。
Wood Mackenzie 副总裁兼金属和采矿咨询主管帕特里克·巴恩斯 (Patrick Barnes) 在论坛上表示：“现在是建设冶炼厂的非常艰难的时期。”印度说明了其中的商业风险。阿达尼 (Adani) 价值 12 亿美元的卡奇铜冶炼厂每年需要约 160 万吨精矿才能满负荷运营。彭博社报道的进口记录显示，该公司在 2024 年 2 月至 2026 年 2 月期间获得了所需原料的四分之一以上。有关高杂质精矿相关运营不稳定的报道加剧了人们的担忧，尽管阿达尼对这些说法提出了异议。在其他地方，嘉能可关闭了位于菲尔州的帕萨尔冶炼厂

【原文 English Original】
Pakistan’s ambition to build a domestic copper processing industry risks putting smelters ahead of mines at a time when global refining capacity already exceeds available concentrate supplies.  Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif reinforced that ambition at the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum (PMIF) in Islamabad, pledging to end exports of unprocessed minerals and calling for Reko Diq and other projects in the southwest to support refineries, smelters and factories producing cables and conductors.  “Mine in Pakistan, process in Pakistan, manufacture in Pakistan and then export to the rest of the world,” Sharif said.  The push reflects a desire to capture more jobs, skills and export revenue from Pakistan’s mineral wealth. But with only one producing copper operation, at Saindak, and its flagship Reko Diq project still awaiting commercial production, the country faces a more immediate challenge: establishing reliable mine output before committing billions to processing infrastructure.  Ahsan Iqbal, Pakistan’s federal minister of planning, development and special initiatives, said the government now asks investors to submit complete value-chain proposals rather than plans focused solely on extraction and raw-material exports.  That requirement creates a particular challenge for explorers. Copper smelters are designed around specific concentrates, including their grades, impurities and expected volumes. Without defined mineral resources and dependable production, developers cannot establish the feedstock commitments lenders require.  Munib Hussain, an energy and infrastructure partner at law firm Milbank, said contracted feedstock ranks among the principal requirements for financing such projects.  The distinction is important. In April 2025, I argued that mining alone would not deliver critical minerals independence and that investment in processing should take priority.  That argument concerned the United States, where established mineral deposits and decades of production provided a foundation for downstream investment. Pakistan is at an earlier stage, and the global copper market presents a different economic reality.  Smelting economics  Copper smelters are struggling with excess capacity as new facilities in China compete with expanding operations in India, Central Asia and Africa.  The pressure is evident in treatment and refining charges, which miners pay smelters to convert concentrate into refined metal.  Antofagasta and Chinese smelters agreed to a 2026 benchmark of $0 per tonne and zero cents per pound, down from $21.25 per tonne in 2025 and $80 the previous year. Spot charges have fallen below zero, with S&P Global Platts assessing them at minus $47.40 per tonne in January.  Those negative charges mean processors are effectively paying miners to secure concentrate.  “It’s a very tough time to build a smelter,” Patrick Barnes, vice-president and head of metals and mining consulting at Wood Mackenzie, said at the forum.  India illustrates the commercial risks. Adani’s $1.2-billion Kutch Copper smelter requires approximately 1.6 million tonnes of concentrate annually to operate at full capacity. Import records reported by Bloomberg indicate it secured just over a quarter of its required feedstock between February 2024 and February 2026.  Reports of operating instability linked to high-impurity concentrate have added to concerns, although Adani has disputed those accounts.  Elsewhere, Glencore has closed its Pasar smelter in the Philippines, while Australia has intervened to support the Mount Isa smelter in Queensland.  Even countries that have developed mines before building processing facilities remain exposed to supply disruptions.  Indonesia delayed its copper concentrate export restrictions until production at Grasberg, one of the world’s largest copper mines, could adequately supply domestic smelters. Freeport also had to demonstrate that sufficient concentrate had been reserved for its Manyar facility.  But a September 2025 mud rush at Grasberg forced Freeport to declare force majeure, leaving Indonesian processors short of material.  For Pakistan, these examples strengthen the commercial case for Reko Diq’s existing development plan.  The project is designed to export copper concentrate by rail to Port Qasim for shipment through the Pakistan International Bulk Terminal. Although that approach falls short of the government’s downstream ambitions, it positions Pakistan to benefit from the current shortage of concentrate rather than compete in an oversupplied smelting market.  Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said Reko Diq’s first year of commercial production had been expected to generate $2.8 billion in exports, equivalent to roughly 10% of Pakistan’s current goods exports.  For an economy repeatedly constrained by balance-of-payments crises, that potential foreign exchange revenue is significant.  The opportunity also extends to Western supply chains. American and allied processors need dependable mineral supplies, making Pakistan’s emerging mining industry potentially more valuable as a concentrate exporter than as another entrant into copper smelting.  Domestic processing could still make economic sense for smaller, specialized operations targeting minerals with genuine refining bottlenecks and committed buyers. Antimony is one example, with at least one Pakistani processor pursuing refining capacity linked to prospective US offtake.  Exploration incentives  Pakistan’s taxation policies present another obstacle to establishing the mining industry needed to support future processing.  Waleed Ahmed Vohra, founder and chief executive of Pakistani explorer Ark Metals, said customs duties and taxes consume close to 30% of his exploration budget because the emerging industry depends heavily on imported equipment and foreign technical services.  “I really feel bad when I have to raise a hundred dollars and give 30 dollars to the government,” Vohra said.  Rather than seeking permanent exemptions, he proposes deferring those obligations until commercial production begins, allowing companies to invest more capital in exploration while preserving the government’s eventual tax revenue.  “Defer now to prosper tomorrow,” he said.  Aurangzeb acknowledged the industry’s concerns and said the government would consider changes to taxation and other policies, particularly measures supporting exporters. He pointed to the removal of super taxes in this year’s budget.  But he also emphasized Pakistan’s limited fiscal flexibility, warning that a tax-to-GDP ratio below 10% would be unsustainable. The country has only recently moved into double digits.  That creates a policy dilemma. Export-oriented tax relief provides little immediate benefit to explorers that may spend years defining deposits before generating revenue.  Deferral could bridge that gap without permanently eliminating government receipts, although it would postpone collections and leave the treasury exposed if projects never reach production.  Current incentives nevertheless favour processing.  At the forum, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif announced the province’s first dedicated mineral processing zone at an industrial estate in Khushab, offering industrial land at nominal rent for 15 years alongside customs duty concessions.  Federal relief for explorers, including a reported 30-year sales tax exemption covering exploration and development, remains under consideration.  The contrast is striking: processing investors are receiving concrete incentives while explorers are still seeking comparable support.  Government officials appear increasingly aware of the sequencing challenge. Barnes said discussions at the forum showed that policymakers had carefully examined the conditions necessary to make domestic smelting commercially viable.  “They understand that until there’s a mining industry here, smelting is not really on the table,” he said. “If they get two, three, four mines that are producing, options start to open up for them.”  Pakistan does not need to abandon its processing ambitions. It needs to distinguish between commodities where domestic refining addresses a genuine supply-chain shortage and copper, where existing smelters are already competing for scarce material.  The immediate priority is to make exploration more attractive, establish dependable production and build an export industry capable of financing future downstream investment.  A domestic copper smelter may eventually make sense. Its economic justification will be stronger once Pakistan has several producing mines and the concentrate supply to sustain it.  For now, the furnace can wait for the rock.  * Erik Groves is a contributing analyst for MINING.COM and Corporate Strategy and In-House Counsel at Morgan Companies. He will attend and provide coverage of the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum (PMIF) in Islamabad on November 12 and 13. Event organizers are assisting with travel, accommodation, and interview coordination with key participants. Neither Groves nor MINING.COM is receiving payment for coverage. All reporting, analysis, interview selection and editorial decisions remain independent of the organizers, who have no right to review or approve content before publication .

title: The military lacks an ‘overarching plan’ to improve munition stockpiles—partly because it’s no one’s job
zh_title: 军方缺乏改善弹药库存的“总体计划”——部分原因是这不是任何人的工作
summary: 根据政府问责办公室周四发布的一份研究报告，国防部没有确定、实现或衡量其在实现长期弹药生产目标方面取得的进展的“总体计划”，该研究称军方对全球事件过于敏感，并且没有准备好预测自己的需求。美国政府问责局指出，除其他问题外，武器库存缺乏集中权力，武器库存已因伊朗战争而耗尽，对美国与中国发生潜在冲突的计划至关重要。问题的核心在于军队可以购买的东西和实际需要的东西之间的差异。
content:
根据政府问责办公室周四发布的一份研究报告，国防部没有确定、实现或衡量其在实现长期弹药生产目标方面取得的进展的“总体计划”，该研究称军方对全球事件过于敏感，并且没有准备好预测自己的需求。美国政府问责局指出，除其他问题外，武器库存缺乏集中权力，武器库存已因伊朗战争而耗尽，对美国与中国发生潜在冲突的计划至关重要。问题的核心在于军方可以购买的东西与实际需要的东西之间存在差异，政府问责局表示，这甚至可能导致弹药投资超出五角大楼的要求。该报告的作者写道：“虽然国防部正在采取措施关注弹药短缺问题，但它无法解决这些差距。” “国防部没有总体计划，也没有指定和授权的领导层来改善弹药库存并满足其弹药需求。由于没有确定长期目标、实现这些目标的战略以及衡量进展的指标，国防部无法确定其行动是否能够解决弹药短缺问题。”包括国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯在内的高级政府官员否认美国存在弹药短缺，尽管有报告和独立分析显示，伊朗冲突已经严重耗尽了弹药。关键武器，尤其是备受追捧的爱国者拦截机，其制造时间可能超过两年。
但在对政府问责局研究的回应中，五角大楼官员同意军方需要制定一项长期计划来提高弹药生产的建议。五角大楼负责采购的代理副手大卫·卡德曼写道：“我们同意需要一个总体框架，更好地整合弹药需求、库存水平、生产、资源和长期目标。”他补充说，国防部“已经执行了政府问责局建议中的许多内容”。美国政府问责局的研究并未探讨特定弹药的库存，而是研究了五角大楼跟踪、预测和总体处理一系列武器（从炮弹到战斧导弹）的过程。 “重要的是，[这项研究]与当前的短缺无关，”战略与国际研究中心的高级顾问马克·坎西恩（Mark Cancian）撰写了大量有关弹药政策的文章。 “这关系到未来并决定长期库存、生产和弹药组合。”  国防官员强调需要“高低”弹药组合，即高科技、难以制造的武器和廉价武器之间的平衡。伊朗战争说明了美军对昂贵拦截机的依赖，这些拦截机投入了大量资金来击落廉价的沙赫德无人机，这些无人机的成本只有数万美元。
彭博资讯国防分析师韦恩·桑德斯表示：“当你拥有先进的能力，并且开始消耗先进的能力来击落快速补充的非先进能力时，这是一场我们赢不了的经济游戏。”“这开始转变为军事领域的一场革命，表明我们必须改变我们的学说，同时改变我们在美国的生产能力。”   美国政府问责局国防能力主管戴安娜·摩尔达夫斯基 (Diana Moldafsky) 在周五发给《防务一号》的一封电子邮件中指出，五角大楼已经发现了不足之处

【原文 English Original】
The Defense Department has no “overarching plan” to identify, achieve, or measure its progress toward long-term munition production goals, according to a Government Accountability Office study released on Thursday, which said the military was too reactive to global events and unprepared to forecast its own needs. The GAO cited—among other issues—a lack of centralized authority over weapons inventories, which have been depleted by the Iran war and are vital to U.S. plans for a potential conflict with China. At the center of the problem lies a discrepancy between what the military can buy and what it actually needs, which the GAO said could even result in munition investments that exceed the Pentagon’s requirements.  “While DOD is taking steps to focus on munitions shortages, it is not positioned to address these gaps,” the report’s authors wrote. “DOD does not have an overarching plan or designated and empowered leadership to improve munition inventories and meet its munitions requirements. By not identifying long-term goals, strategies to achieve them, and metrics to gauge progress, DOD cannot be sure that its actions will address its munition shortfalls. ” Top administration officials, including Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, have denied that the U.S. has a shortage in munitions, despite reports and independent analyses showing the Iran conflict has alarmingly drained key weapons, especially for highly-sought Patriot interceptors that can take more than two years to make. But in its response to the GAO study, Pentagon officials concurred with the recommendation that the military needed to develop a long-term plan to improve its munition production.  “We agree with the need for an overarching framework that better integrates munition requirements, inventory levels, production, resources, and long-term objectives,” wrote David Cadman, the Pentagon’s acting deputy for acquisitions, who added that the department “already executes many elements” of the GAO’s recommendation. The GAO study did not explore the inventories of specific munitions, but examined the processes by which an expansive list of weapons — from artillery shells to Tomahawk missiles — are tracked, forecast and generally addressed by the Pentagon. “The important thing is that [the study] is not about current shortages,” Mark Cancian, a senior adviser with the Center for Strategic and International Studies who has written extensively on munitions policy. “It's about the future and deciding long-term inventories, production, and munitions mixes.”  Defense officials have emphasized the need for a “high-low” mix of munitions—that is, a balance between high-tech, hard-to-make weapons and cheaper ones. The Iran war illustrated the U.S. military’s reliance on expensive interceptors, which were heavily expended to shoot down cheap Shahed drones that only cost tens of thousands of dollars.  “When you have an exquisite capacity, and you are starting to expend an exquisite capacity to knock down non-exquisite capabilities that are rapidly replenished, it is an economical game that we're not going to win,” said Wayne Sanders, a defense analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence. “This is starting to turn into one of those revolutions in military affairs to say we have to change our doctrine as well as we change our production capacity in the U.S.”   In an email to Defense One on Friday, the GAO’s director for defense capabilities, Diana Moldafsky, noted that the Pentagon had identified shortfalls before the conflict with Iran, but said that the war “made addressing those shortages more urgent.” “Our key point is that meeting DOD's munitions requirements will be challenging,” Moldafsky said. “A department-wide plan would help the department direct its resources towards its most critical munitions needs.”  Cancian said that Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine, and the consequent transfer of Patriots and other weapons to Kyiv, introduced concerns about the defense industrial base and its ability to respond to munition needs around the world. Meanwhile, the Pentagon has inked billions of dollars in multi-year “framework agreements” with top defense companies over the last year to help increase high-tech munition production, which require funding from Congress to come to fruition. The Trump administration also invoked the Defense Production Act earlier this year in an attempt to bolster munition supply chains. A Pentagon spokesperson declined to address the GAO study directly, or even to be quoted by name. But they said the military is “fully equipped to strike at the time and place of the President’s choosing…while preserving a deep, ready stockpile to defend our people and interests.” Part of the problem is that no one authority is really in charge of keeping arsenals topped off and ready, the report found.  The GAO identified several Pentagon offices and working groups, including individual service entities, responsible for managing munition inventories, but no one dedicated authority “that empowers the leadership to make decisions that improve munitions inventories department-wide and hold them accountable for the outcomes achieved, such as improving munitions inventory levels.” The study also said that the services maintain separate tools to track munition inventories, which then feed into a Pentagon system known as the Munitions Readiness Initiative. But researchers said the DOD has limited oversight over that tracking platform and hasn’t regularly reconciled it with service-level numbers. Citing an unnamed Pentagon official in its acquisitions and sustainment office, the GAO said “the office was reluctant to impose additional responsibilities on the services for maintaining data to meet MRI’s needs because they recognize that the services already face numerous responsibilities in managing their own munitions inventory data.” The Pentagon concurred with most of the GAO’s recommendations, but only partially agreed with one: that the data management plan be run out of the DOD’s digital and AI office. Cadman’s response said that the Pentagon’s acquisition and sustainment arm was best suited to develop it. ]]>

title: The Hydrogen Stream: China starts operating 195 km hydrogen pipeline

据新华社报道，中国已开始运营连接达尔汗木明干联合旗和内蒙古包头市的一条全长195公里的氢气管道。该管道的批准年运输能力为10万吨氢气，有可能增加到24万吨。该基础设施由内蒙古华电华盟管道开发，将连接包头北部的可再生氢气生产设施与南部的工业消费者。据新华社报道，管道运输可以将氢气输送成本从管式拖车的约 13 元/公斤（1.83 美元）/公斤降低到约 3 元/公斤。中国一直在扩大氢能运输基础设施，以将可再生能源与工业需求连接起来。 ACME集团已就印度奥里萨邦投资36亿美元的绿色氨项目达成最终投资决定（FID），该项目年产能76万吨。该设施计划于 2029 年投入运行，将配备由蒂森克虏伯伍德设计的日产 2,200 吨的氨生产回路。它将利用可再生电力通过电解生产氢气，用于绿色氨生产，目标客户是印度、日本和欧洲。 Brookfield 已承诺提供高达 6 亿美元的资金来支持 ACME 的绿色分子平台。该项目预计每年可避免超过150万吨温室气体排放。 ACME还在印度获得了绿色氨供应合同，并正在开发绿色甲醇项目。

【原文 English Original】
China has started operating a 195 km hydrogen pipeline connecting Darhan Muminggan United Banner with Baotou, Inner Mongolia, reported Xinhua News Agency. The pipeline has an approved annual transport capacity of 100,000 tons of hydrogen, potentially increasing to 240,000 tons. Developed by Inner Mongolia Huadian Huameng Pipeline, the infrastructure will connect renewable hydrogen production facilities in northern Baotou with industrial consumers in the south. Pipeline transport could reduce hydrogen delivery costs from about CNY 13 ($1.83)/kg by tube trailer to approximately CNY 3/kg, according to Xinhua. China has been expanding its hydrogen transport infrastructure to connect renewable energy resources with industrial demand. ACME Group has reached a final investment decision (FID) on a $3.6 billion green ammonia project in Odisha, India, with an annual production capacity of 760,000 tons. The facility, scheduled for commissioning in 2029, will feature a 2,200-ton-per-day ammonia production loop designed by Thyssenkrupp Uhde. It will use renewable electricity to produce hydrogen through electrolysis for green ammonia production, targeting customers in India, Japan and Europe. Brookfield has committed up to $600 million to support ACME’s green molecules platform. The project is expected to avoid more than 1.5 million tons of greenhouse gas emissions annually. ACME has also secured green ammonia supply contracts in India and is developing green methanol projects. Researchers in Chile have found that green hydrogen produced from curtailed solar electricity could achieve a levelized cost of hydrogen (LCOH) as low as $5.58/kg, compared with $7.27/kg for the most competitive wind projects. The study, “ Green hydrogen from curtailment: Real data analysis ,” assessed operational data from 56 solar plants and 44 wind farms with a combined capacity of 10.4 GW between July 2023 and June 2024. Curtailment occurred in about 25% of recorded hourly intervals, predominantly at low power levels. Using a techno-economic model based on proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzers, the researchers identified optimal electrolyzer capacities of 5% to 13% of the renewable plants’ net effective power across the 10 best-performing projects, all located in northern Chile. The projects achieved LCOH values of $5.58/kg to $6.97/kg, with electrolyzer capacity factors of 25% to 30%. Deviations of up to 50% from optimal electrolyzer sizing increased hydrogen production costs by no more than 3.8%. The study, to be published in Energy Reports , found that curtailed renewable electricity could support competitive hydrogen production, although storage, compression and transport costs remain additional considerations. Chile has experienced significant renewable energy curtailment , particularly at solar plants in the north of the country. Qair has inaugurated its Hyd’Occ renewable hydrogen production facility in Occitanie, France. The 20 MW plant is supported by a regional network of hydrogen refueling stations forming part of the European H2 Corridor. Qair opened its first hydrogen refueling stations in Béziers and Narbonne in spring 2026. A second development phase will double the plant’s installed capacity to 40 MW, increasing annual hydrogen production capacity to 5,400 tons. Total investment amounts to €130 million. Plug Power has launched GenEco Scale, an integrated electrolyzer plant offering for utility-scale hydrogen production. Arcadia eFuels has selected the system for a 280 MW hydrogen facility at its Project ARC development in Texas. Plug Power said it has completed the project’s technical evaluation and front-end engineering design (FEED) study. Once operational, the facility is expected to support production of approximately 23.2 million gallons of electro-sustainable aviation fuel (e-SAF) annually. Plug Power previously signed a 280 MW electrolyzer supply agreement with Arcadia eFuels for a separate project in Denmark. Protium has completed due diligence for two green hydrogen projects under the UK government’s second Hydrogen Allocation Round (HAR2). The South Tees Net Zero project in northern England and the South Wales Net Zero project have both advanced to the Invitation to Offer stage. The 70 MW South Tees facility is designed to produce up to 11,000 tons of green hydrogen annually, equivalent to about 433 GWh, for industrial consumers in Teesside. The projects will now progress toward Low Carbon Hydrogen Agreements, which provide revenue support to reduce investment risks. Protium is also developing other UK hydrogen projects , including a 15 MW electrolyzer project that secured support under the first Hydrogen Allocation Round. content:
從台灣的倉頡換成大陸的漢語拼音：電腦輸入法會影響下一代學習中文嗎？ - BBC News 中文
圖像加註文字，倉頡碼開發於台灣，卻在香港長期受到廣泛應用。
10月底，香港特區教育局公布小學創科課程草擬文件，提出小學二年級學生應該初步掌握以中國普通話為基礎的「漢語拼音輸入法」輸入中文，引起社會熱議。
過去，教育局沒有規定學校應該教哪一種輸入法，而倉頡及其簡化版速成一直是港人常用選擇。
這份建議的出現，正好發生在倉頡輸入法雛形誕生50週年之際。
從倉頡到漢語拼音輸入，表面是打字方式的選擇，背後卻涉及文化改變及語言系統轉換。自2008年開始，港府已積極推廣學校用普通話教授中國語文。在此背景下，引入漢語拼音輸入做法再次觸碰港人神經。
「你會思考（政策）是不是要再削弱廣東話在香港的地位、要把普通話再普及化等等。」儘管從小用漢語拼音打字，今年32歲的梁先生說，這是他看到新聞後的第一想法。
另外有反對聲音擔心，拼音輸入法會影響學童的認字能力，甚至改變用語思維。教育局後來解釋，學生在普通話堂已經學習漢語拼音，有初步語音基礎，認為採用拼音輸入是「學以致用、相輔相成」。
輸入法會影響下一代學習語言嗎？有學者向BBC中文指出，輸入法本質是一項工具，未必直接左右學童的語言能力。而比起輸入法本身，學童目前身處語言環境的改變更值得關注。
圖像來源，South China Morning Post via Getty Images
圖像加註文字，2008年開始，教育局推出「以普通話教授中國語文科」計劃，簡稱「普教中」。
這是教育局首次在課程文件中，明確提出學生應該掌握的中文輸入法。
早在2000年，政府就小學生的中文輸入能力訂下學習目標。時任教育統籌局局長王永平表示，小一至小三學生要學習用手寫輸入；而小四至小六學生則用鍵盤輸入。
但當時政府強調，不會規定學校教哪一種輸入法，因為「輸入法只是一種工具」，重點是令學生學懂打字，運用電腦學習。
而據教育署資料顯示，當時大部分學校教速成，職場上則普遍用倉頡。
香港教育大學數學與資訊科技學系副教授黎耀志博士向BBC中文指出，倉頡在香港流行的原因很「直觀」：因為「沒有別的選擇」。
中文輸入法主要分字形和字音兩種：拆解文字的倉頡、速成屬前者，描述讀音的拼音則屬後者。與台灣和中國大陸使用注音符號和漢語拼音不同，粵語過去未有形成一套統一拼音系統。但倉頡輸入並不依賴讀音。
倉頡由台灣電腦科學家朱邦復發明，目的是讓漢字可以用英文鍵盤輸入電腦。他把漢字按部首、筆劃拆解成不同字根，再對應24個英文字母進行編碼。每個漢字最多可拆五個碼。
速成輸入法是倉頡的「簡化版」：輸入時只需要取首尾兩個碼，然後再選字。
圖像加註文字，1999年8月26日，朱邦復先生（左）探訪香港教育大學（時為香港教育學院），黎耀志（中）及其兒子與先生合影。
黎耀志說，倉頡不易上手，使用者要理解漢字的結構、記住獨有的拆碼規則，「比較難學」。但輸入法能否成為主流，除了易不易學，也與使用者習慣、技術發展等有關。
例如，倉頡雖在台灣發明，但台灣人從小開始學習注音符號，所以注音仍然是當地主流輸入法。中國大陸曾流行把漢字拆成筆劃的「五筆輸入法」，但因為拼音輸入法日益進步，聯想詞越來越準確和快速，五筆的使用率就逐漸下降。
至於香港，利用數字鍵輸入選字的「九方輸入法」一度流行，但隨着數字鍵盤式微、「九方」開始收費，使用人群便減少。對比之下，為了普及中文電腦，朱邦復於1982年主動放棄專利權，使倉頡成為電腦內置的標準輸入法之一。
除此之外，倉頡重碼率低，輸入效率高，也成為上班族的首選。
香港教育大學語言學及現代語言系助理教授劉擇明記得，自己大約在1995年開始用電腦，當時微軟視窗（Microsoft Windows）作業系統已預設有倉頡、大易、行列等輸入法。他每一種都試過，系統不同，速度有快有慢，但倉頡剛剛處在平衡：有學習門檻、要練習，但學習時間合理。
到1990年代中後期甚至千禧年代初，公司開始大量使用電腦，劉擇明記得當時香港「滿街都是倉頡班」。普羅大眾坐在課室裡硬背字碼，聽着老師在黑板前教拆字，「想練的人就保持用倉頡，很快放棄的那些人就由倉頡變做速成」。
圖像加註文字，中文輸入法主要分字形和字音兩種：拆解文字的倉頡速成屬前者，描述讀音的拼音則屬後者。
從「國安教育」到「愛國主義教育」，北京如何逐步改造香港人思想2024年10月1日
香港國安法5週年：你愛國嗎？國安教育工程下的師生和公眾怎麼看2025年6月30日
香港教育局指引學生以漢語拼音輸入中文，理由是能提高學習效率。
局方指，學生已經學習過漢字拼音，用拼音輸入法是「學與教效能」原則下的「最佳選擇」。但外界爭議，安排長遠會對學生學習中文造成影響。
今年29歲的梁景鴻或有切身體會。他在深圳出生，小學教授普通話，故自7歲開始使用漢語拼音輸入。2009年，他移居香港。在他印象中，小學電腦室配有手寫板，但沒有強制學生使用哪一種輸入法。
到了中學，身邊同學主要使用速成。梁景鴻坦言，由於使用漢語拼音輸入，自己曾被同學取笑是「大陸仔」，「你會介意的，但沒有辦法、改變不到」。
他試過學速成，但速度始終比不上漢語拼音。香港特區政府文書職系要求中文打字每分鐘達20字——用漢語拼音，梁景鴻每分鐘可以打到77個字，屬於水平之上。
不過長期使用，他確實感到在書寫方面有影響，「真的會容易忘記字怎麼寫」。「我不需要知道每一粒字是怎樣組成、怎樣的結構，我只需要輸入（字母），一個中文字出來大概是那個樣子的， 我就知道是那個字」。
這是外界對學生使用拼音輸入的其中一種擔憂：倉頡速成要求使用者充分了解漢字結構，字音輸入僅依賴讀音拼字，長遠下去會加劇執筆忘字的情況。
香港浸會大學中國語言文學系一級講師蕭欣浩向BBC中文表示，現在的輸入法已附帶詞語聯想功能，所以倉頡、速成使用者未必需要認識每個字詞，也可以完成輸入。
不過他同意，中小學生正值累積詞彙、建立漢字記憶的階段，使用拼音輸入法可能會影響他們對漢字的理解。「速成也要拆字，你會知道它（字部首）是草字頭、是木字，但拼音的話，你會讀就可以了。」
為了解決忘詞問題，梁景鴻曾在手機裡加入筆劃輸入法，但最終衡量下來，打字速度始終不夠拼音快。
「如果可以分程度的話，語音輸入法（很大機會）會忘字，普通話拼音可能在中間，如果是手寫輸入法就一定不會忘了。」梁景鴻形容。
劉擇明則認為，字形字音輸入法各有長處：字形輸入可以訓練使用者對漢字的部件意識，而字音則可訓練語音靈敏度，「如果我只用字形輸入法，也可以用了30年你都不會讀那個字。」
在他看來，要解決忘字或錯別字問題，不能單靠使用字形輸入法，更重要是在學科上加強學生漢字部件的意識。
圖像加註文字，有學者指中小學生正值累積詞彙、建立漢字記憶時期，使用拼音輸入法或會影響對漢字的理解。
不過，社會的憂慮並不限於學生書寫能力的變化，更要放在香港整體語言環境轉變中理解。
香港中小學一直設有普通話科。2008年開始，教育局再推出「以普通話教授中國語文科」計劃，簡稱「普教中」。學校可因應校情，自行決定實施模式。
根據香港語文教育及研究常務委員會2016年的統計，有71.7%小學全級或於部份班級推行「普教中」。此後「語常會」未有再發表相關研究。近年則有本地媒體自行統計，發現香港仍有44%小學推行「普教中」。
教育局局長蔡若蓮曾指，學好普通話有利融入中國發展大局、增強民族自豪感和自信。而為配合粵港澳大灣區發展，教育局有責任培養學生普通話能力。
雖然教育局重申「兩文三語」政策不變，但在「普教中」持續推行的背景下，學童學習使用漢語拼音輸入法，觸發大眾對港府「推普滅粵」的擔憂。
「你會思考（政策）是不是要再削弱廣東話在香港的地位、要把普通話再普及化等等。」梁先生說。
今年32歲的梁先生，中小學均就讀本地國際學校，中文課以普通話授課，日常主要用英文和朋友溝通。直到中三、四認識校外朋友後，他開始學習中文輸入法，「在電話和電腦的鍵盤清單，唯一認識的就是拼音。」
他曾嘗試學習倉頡速成，「上YouTube看教學，我明白它的基本邏輯，但怎樣拆成Keyboard的部份則不能理解」。對他來說，漢語拼音沒有學習門檻，「等於你識英文就打到英文」。
根據特區政府統計處《2021年人口普查主題性報告：兒童》，88.3%香港兒童以廣東話作為家中最常用的交談語言。有聲音擔心，學童用漢語拼音打字，需要在腦內先把粵語轉換成普通話，長久下去壓縮廣東話的使用。
不過，梁先生的經驗並非完全如此。他自小用粵語和英語思考，認為思考語言早已成形，漢語拼音輸入法是後天學習的工具，所以在輸入時並不存在要把粵語翻譯到普通話的過程。
梁景鴻也有同樣感受。他表示自己在打字時是用粵語去思考，只不過廣東話中有不少獨有的助語詞，使用漢語拼音輸入需要刻意背誦，例如「唔」是「WU」、「嘅」是「KAI」，「咁」是「GAN」。
但梁先生不確認，在小學階段使用漢語拼音輸入會否改變思維，「讓他們多了理由去用普通話思考？」
蕭欣浩則認為，學童單用漢語拼音輸入未必會使粵語退步，但從宏觀的環境來看，學童本身學習語言環境早已發生改變，更令人值得關注。
「中文用普通話教、詞彙用普通話讀、日常生活溝通用普通話，現在連打字都用普通話，這個連帶關係可能會加重減少粵語思考和運用的時間。」
蕭欣浩在大學講學，留意到不少學生使用語言的習慣深受社交媒體影響，「比如作文，很明顯（看到）全部作文有穿越、宮廷等等（元素）」。
年輕人日常使用的潮語，也越來越多普通話用詞。早前，有香港社交媒體內容創作者隨機街訪數位「00後」年輕人，了解時下流行的潮語，當中有受訪者回答「繃不住」、「那咋了」。影片令本地網民訝然，感嘆潮語已經變得「大陸化」。
「為什麼（他們）現在講的是普通話潮語呢？就是聽得多嘛。」蕭欣浩說。
從節省教學時間的現實層面而言，蕭欣浩理解教育局的考量。但在「普教中」的大環境下，他認為漢語拼音輸入可視為其中一個配套，「去加強普通話學習」。
在倉頡和漢語拼音的討論以外，有人提出第三個選項——粵語拼音（粵拼）。
劉擇明一直積極推廣粵拼，創立過網上中文粵語詞典《粵典》。他強調，香港社會以粵語為主，學生要表達自己，「用粵語一定是好一些」。
「如果母語可以用字音輸入法，就可以鞏固返每一顆字的音，」劉擇明說。
不過，目前粵拼未被納入正規課程。教育局曾表示，粵語拼音輸入法等標音系統「缺乏一致性」，師生不容易掌握和熟習。梁景鴻和梁先生也曾嘗試學粵拼，但因為網絡上有不同的拼音方案，難以作出選擇。
劉擇明解釋，經過數年的發展和整合，粵拼在系統、教材和工具上已經「準備就緒」，只等待官方去推廣，而現時香港已經有特殊學校使用粵拼教授中文。
面對教育局建議漢語拼音，劉擇明理解局方望降低學生學習門檻。但他指出，輸入法教學不只考驗學生，也考驗老師對普通話的熟悉程度。
在他看來，目前課綱只建議三節課，課時僅得105分鐘，學生未必能在短時間內掌握一套輸入法。但老師可以讓學生了解到，輸入法並非只有一種，「拼音也不只得普通話」。
圖像加註文字，根據香港政府統計處《2021年人口普查主題性報告：兒童》，88.3%兒童以廣東話作為家中最常用的交談語言。
1976年，朱邦復開發出「中文形意檢字法」，至1979年獲得當時台灣三軍大學校長，蔣介石養子蔣緯國將軍建議，更名「倉頡輸入法」。
1990年代末，互聯網應用開始興起，他創立網站，整合倉頡輸入法教材，又加入拆字動畫、互動測驗等元素。當時，朱邦復留意到這網站，專程飛來香港與黎耀志會面，二人之後共同建立「倉頡之友・香港」項目，推廣香港人使用倉頡輸入法。
不過黎耀志坦言，這些年已很少留意輸入法的變化。因為隨着科技發展，輸入法早已不是資訊科技科的討論重點，「大家都將好多精力集中早幾年的STEM（科學、技術、工程與數學）、STEAM（科學、科技、工程、藝術與數學），甚至現在可能每間學校都在講AI。」
面對使用者的流失和變化，黎耀志看得淡然，坦言不會感到可惜，「各適其適就是最好的結果」。
在大學教書的劉擇明也發現，現在不少學生不懂得打字，「以前就語音輸入，或者很痛苦地在keyboard找字母，螳螂拳那樣打字；現在有了（Chat）GPT就再衰一些，語音講個字，然後GPT生成文章。」
劉擇明覺得隨着時代發展，工具會慢慢轉變，「現在都沒人用打字機了，所以工具真的會被淘汰。」不過在他看來，即便現在多人用語音輸入，但效果未能達到完全準確，最後仍要靠使用者自行修正，所以輸入法短期內未必會被取代。
他重申，每種輸入法都是不同模態，就像不同樂器，有易有難。輸入法沒有高低之分、從倉頡轉用拼音也不能稱為「退步」。
劉擇明說，當打字不再是「揾食必備技能」，表面上是少了人懂得倉頡速成，但換個角度看，這些人其實是「找到自己的方法去打字」。
蕭欣浩也認同。在現在的環境下，大眾很易把對政治意見、對粵語和繁體字的情感，甚至言語間的隔閡混為一談。但說到底，輸入法本質是工具，它在不同的時代流行，也會有被淘汰的一日。

与中国有关的黑客利用关键的 VMware vCenter 零日漏洞获取管理员访问权限并窃取数据
与中国有关的黑客利用关键的 VMware vCenter 零日漏洞获取管理员访问权限并窃取数据
Swati Khandelwal报告2026年11月20日漏洞/网络间谍活动
涉嫌与中国有联系的网络间谍组织 Armoury Castle（以前称为 UNC5221）被归因于 2026 年 9 月上旬对 VMware vCenter Server 中一个关键安全漏洞的零日利用。
该漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-123890（CVSS 评分：9.8），是 VMware Directory Service 中的身份验证绕过案例，可被利用来获得对系统的未经授权的访问。
它已作为 2026 年 11 月 19 日发布的补丁的一部分在以下版本中得到解决 -
VMware Cloud Foundation、VMware vSphere Foundation 9.1.x.x - 已在 9.1.1.0200 中修复
VMware Cloud Foundation、VMware vSphere Foundation 9.0.x.x - 已在 9.0.2.0200 中修复
VMware vCenter 8.0 - 在 8.0 U3m 中修复
VMware vCenter 7.0（如果有扩展支持合同，请联系 Broadcom 支持）
VMware Cloud Foundation - 已在 5.2.5 中修复
VMware Telco Cloud Platform - 在 vCenter 8.0 U3m 中已修复（TCI：3.0、TCP：3.0、4.x、5.0.x、5.1.x、5.2）
VMware Telco 云基础架构 - 在 vCenter 8.0 U3m 中已修复（TCI：3.0、TCP：3.0、4.x、5.0.x、5.1.x、5.2）
谷歌威胁情报小组和 Mandiant 表示：“CVE-2026-123890 是分布式计算环境/远程过程调用 (DCE/RPC) 上未经身份验证的安全远程密码 (SRP-6a) 会话密钥泄露漏洞。”
“成功利用该漏洞会导致远程身份验证绕过，从而创建一个以administrator@vsphere.local 身份建立的经过身份验证的会话。”
攻击者可以利用该漏洞获取经过身份验证的管理员会话、执行任意命令并使用目录服务（“vmdird”）获取文件，例如 data.mdb 数据库。这家科技巨头的威胁情报和事件响应团队表示，他们观察到中国黑客组织使用名为 BONESAW 的实用程序将该漏洞武器化。
谷歌表示：“BONESAW 是一个主要是为了促进用 Golang 编写的远程攻击而构建的实用程序，它利用 CVE-2026-123890 来窃取任意闪电内存映射数据库 (LMDB)、劫持 SAML 安全令牌服务 (STS) 并创建单点登录 (SSO) 管理员帐户。”
该活动是同一活动的一部分，该活动还涉及利用 BeyondTrust Remote Support 中当时的零日漏洞（CVE-2026-102764，CVSS 评分：9.3）进行侦察、获取管理控制、建立持久性并部署名为 BARECLAW 的定制代理隧道器。
据称，威胁行为者已从远程支持设备横向转移到内部 Linux 设备，将权限升级为 root，并部署额外的有效负载以扩大其访问范围、绘制环境图、进行数据盗窃并进入虚拟化环境。
谷歌表示：“该组织利用 nmap 扫描内部环境，查找运行特定于 VMware 的开放端口的系统，即端口 9080、5480 和 2012。” “值得注意的是，端口 2012 用作 vCenter Single Sign-On (SSO) 的控制接口 RPC，并且是 Armory Castle 通过 BONESAW 远程利用 CVE-2026-123890 的一个组成部分。”
作为攻击的一部分，部署了六个已识别的恶意软件系列和实用程序 -
SLIMSAVAGE 和 CAGEMATCH，JSP Web shell，旨在运行任意命令、暂存有效负载并建立

China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
Swati KhandelwalNov 20, 2026Vulnerability / Cyber Espionage
The suspected China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical security flaw in VMware vCenter Server in early September 2026.
The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123890 (CVSS score: 9.8), is a case of authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service that could be exploited to gain unauthorized access to the system.
It has been addressed as part of patches released on November 19, 2026, in the following versions -
VMware Cloud Foundation, VMware vSphere Foundation 9.1.x.x - Fixed in 9.1.1.0200
VMware Cloud Foundation, VMware vSphere Foundation 9.0.x.x - Fixed in 9.0.2.0200
VMware vCenter 8.0 - Fixed in 8.0 U3m
VMware vCenter 7.0 (Contact Broadcom Support, if on extended support contract)
VMware Cloud Foundation - Fixed in 5.2.5
VMware Telco Cloud Platform - Fixed in vCenter 8.0 U3m (TCI: 3.0, TCP: 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2)
VMware Telco Cloud Infrastructure - Fixed in vCenter 8.0 U3m (TCI: 3.0, TCP: 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2)
"CVE-2026-123890 is an unauthenticated Secure Remote Password (SRP-6a) session key disclosure vulnerability over Distributed Computing Environment/Remote Procedure Calls (DCE/RPC)," Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant said.
"Successful exploitation results in a remote authentication bypass which creates an authenticated session established as administrator@vsphere.local."
An attacker can exploit the vulnerability to obtain an authenticated administrator session, execute arbitrary commands, and acquire files, such as the data.mdb database, by using the Directory Service ("vmdird"). The tech giant's threat intelligence and incident response teams said it observed the Chinese hacking group weaponizing the flaw using a utility dubbed BONESAW.
"BONESAW is a utility primarily built to facilitate remote exploitation written in Golang, which utilizes CVE-2026-123890 to exfiltrate the arbitrary Lightning Memory-Mapped Database (LMDB), hijack the SAML Security Token Service (STS), and create a Single Sign On (SSO) Administrator account," Google said.
The activity is part of the same campaign that also involved the exploitation of a then zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764, CVSS score: 9.3) to conduct reconnaissance, obtain administrative control, establish persistence, and deploy a bespoke proxy tunneler called BARECLAW.
From the Remote Support device, the threat actor is said to have moved laterally to an internal Linux appliance, escalated privileges to root, and deployed additional payloads to broaden their access, map the environment, conduct data theft, and move into the virtualized environment.
"The group leveraged nmap to scan the internal environment for systems running open ports specific to VMware, namely ports 9080, 5480, and 2012," Google said. "Notably, port 2012 is used as the control interface RPC for vCenter Single Sign-On (SSO) and is an integral part of Armory Castle's remote exploitation of CVE-2026-123890 through BONESAW."
Deployed as part of the attack are six identified malware families and utilities -
SLIMSAVAGE and CAGEMATCH, JSP web shells designed to run arbitrary commands, stage payloads, and establish a foothold on the Linux appliance.
BONESAW, the Golang-based remote exploitation utility for CVE-2026-123890 used to target an internal vCenter Server.
SAWSNAKE, a Golang utility that enables vCenter SAML authentication bypass and session cookie generation, thereby making it possible to conduct Golden SAML attacks against vCenter following the successful execution of BONESAW and allowing the attacker to forge authentication tokens, bypass multi-factor authentication(MFA), and impersonate any user. It's a Go-based port of an open-source Python script named "vcenter_saml_login.py."
BEARBONES, a C backdoor based on the open-source Dropbear SSH Server that's capable of bypassing system password authentication, logging plaintext credentials, and loading or generating server host keys from the temporary directory.
LAZYBONES, a lightweight Go backdoor that uses Slack for command-and-control (C2) communications and has been previously deployed in a separate intrusion in early 2025 following the successful exploitation of a critical flaw in Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2025-22457, CVSS score: 9.0).
It's suspected that Armory Castle had knowledge of the flaw prior to the disclosure of CVE-2026-59309 on July 29, 2026, with the recovered BONESAW binary containing a build timestamp of July 13, 2026. However, it's worth noting that build metadata can be modified before compilation.
"After the execution of BEARBONES to create a listener on TCP port 33992, Armory Castle moved laterally to the vCenter appliance as the Administrator and created a local administrator account named sps-<REDACTED>@vsphere.local," Google said.
"Notably, Armory Castle enabled SSH on vCenter via the vCenter Server Appliance Management Interface (VAMI) API through a PUT request to /rest/appliance/access/ssh. After enabling SSH, Armory Castle connected to the vCenter via SSH using the newly created local administrator account."
In the final stage of the attack, the adversary was found enumerating the ESXi file system, mounting Virtual Machine File System (VMFS) volumes, and adding an SSH public key to the root account's authorized keys. It also conducted additional reconnaissance and data theft on the ESXi file system, which were then archived and downloaded via HTTP GET requests to the Remote Support appliance for subsequent exfiltration.
Furthermore, the attackers have been observed dropping LAZYBONES to a separate Linux appliance, which periodically checks for commands from a designated Slack channel, allowing it to perform command execution, file transfer, and beacon interval adjustment.
CVE-2026-123890 is the second vulnerability in a VMware product to be exploited by Armory Castle as a zero-day this year alone. Late last month, CrowdStrike revealed it identified incidents where the hacking crew abused CVE-2026-41709 (CVSS score: 2.7), an insufficient logging flaw in VMware ESX, to reduce audit trail visibility.
"BONESAW represents a significant expansion into post-compromise use of zero-days," Google said. "The group's use of VMware-specific tools like SAWSNAKE and vmfs_browser.py, alongside malware designed to operate on Remote Support and Linux systems, represent a diverse toolset including capabilities specifically tailored to target several different appliances, demonstrating the threat actor's deep understanding of each."
"The use of three separate specialized sets of malware and two zero-days in the course of a single campaign indicates that there are significant resources supporting Armory Castle operations. It also shows the extent of the threat actor's operational commitment to compromise high-priority targets."

黑客利用自主人工智能工具Cairn寻找零日漏洞并接管服务器
黑客利用自主人工智能工具Cairn寻找零日漏洞并接管服务器
黑客利用自主人工智能工具Cairn寻找零日漏洞并接管服务器
黑客使用名为“Cairn”的自主人工智能代理平台发现医学成像应用程序中的零日漏洞，并利用它来完全控制服务器。
据亚马逊威胁情报称，疑似与中国有关的攻击者只是指示人工智能代理“获得 shell 访问权限”，让他们独立发现和利用该漏洞。
Amazon Threat Intelligence 发现攻击者在未经身份验证的情况下公开访问其 Cairn 实例，从而暴露了他们的黑客操作，从而发现了该活动。
研究人员称，这些攻击是由与中国有联系的威胁行为者于 2026 年 9 月 8 日至 10 日期间发起的，主要针对中国以外的东亚教育机构。
Cairn 是一个合法的渗透测试工具，可用于协调网络操作中的多个人工智能代理，专为研究和防御强化而创建。
Gambit Security 记录了 9 月份大规模信用卡盗窃行动中的 Cairn 滥用案件。最近，谷歌报告称，它被部署在针对美国一家航空航天组织的攻击中。
在亚马逊调查的活动中，人工智能代理并不总是成功。例如，花费 16 小时、执行 148 次操作来控制 Redis 服务器的努力失败了。
在针对大学 GPU 服务器的单独案例中，特工在 6 小时内尝试了 30,000 多个凭据组合，但未能暴力破解。
据亚马逊称，Cairn 的 AI 代理在 MONAI Label 中发现了路径遍历零日漏洞，MONAI Label 是一款开源医学成像应用程序，使用 AI 帮助研究人员标记医学图像。
该缺陷使代理能够将文件写入服务器上的任意位置，并且在 11 分钟内，他们从映射应用程序的 API 到利用该漏洞。
在随后的会话中，AI 代理利用该缺陷将 Python 反向 shell 写入 sitecustomize.py 文件，该文件在 Python 启动时自动加载，然后触发 API 端点以建立对服务器的 root 访问权限。
发现零日漏洞后，运营商为代理提供了进入第二个大学网络的代理，该网络运行相同的易受攻击的软件，并引导他们瞄准其他机器。
亚马逊向 MONAI Label 维护人员报告了该缺陷，他们于 11 月 18 日发布了安全更新来解决该问题。
研究人员根据检索到的提示语言、活动时间戳和目标选择，以中等信心将该活动归因于与中国有联系的威胁行为者。
亚马逊还共享了 2026 年 9 月 8 日至 10 日期间观察到的与该活动相关的两个 IP 地址：
亚马逊警告说，人工智能代理发现和利用漏洞的速度比安全团队的反应速度更快，敦促组织更多地依赖自动防御而不是手动调查。

Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server
Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server
Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server
Hackers used an autonomous AI agent platform called "Cairn" to discover a zero-day vulnerability in a medical imaging application and exploit it to take complete control of a server.
According to Amazon Threat Intelligence, the suspected Chinese-linked attackers simply instructed the AI agents to "obtain shell access," leaving them to independently discover and exploit the flaw.
Amazon Threat Intelligence uncovered the campaign after discovering that the attackers had left their Cairn instance publicly accessible without authentication, exposing their hacking operations.
According to the researchers, the attacks were launched by a Chinese-nexus threat actor between September 8 and 10, 2026, targeting mainly East Asian educational institutions outside China.
Cairn is a legitimate pentesting tool that can be used to coordinate multiple AI agents in cyber-operations, created for research and defense strengthening.
Gambit Security documented cases of Cairn abuse as part of a large-scale credit card stealing operation in September. More recently, Google reported it was deployed in an attack against an aerospace organization in the U.S.
During the campaign investigated by Amazon, the AI agents were not always successful. For example, a 16-hour and 148-action effort to take control of a Redis server failed.
In a separate case targeting a university GPU server, the agents tried over 30,000 credential combinations over six hours but failed to brute-force their way in.
According to Amazon, Cairn's AI agents found a path traversal zero-day in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging application that uses AI to help researchers label medical images.
The flaw enabled the agents to write files to arbitrary locations on the server, and within 11 minutes, they went from mapping the application's API to exploiting the vulnerability.
In a subsequent session, the AI agents used the flaw to write a Python reverse shell to the sitecustomize.py file that automatically loads when Python starts, then triggered an API endpoint to establish root access to the server.
After discovering the zero-day, the operator provided the agents with a proxy into a second university network running the same vulnerable software and directed them to target other machines.
Amazon reported the flaw to MONAI Label maintainers, and they released a security update to address it on November 18.
The researchers attributed the campaign to a Chinese-nexus threat actor with moderate confidence, based on the language of the retrieved prompts, the activity timestamps, and the choice of targets.
Amazon also shared two IP addresses associated with the campaign, observed between September 8 and 10, 2026:
Amazon warned that AI agents can find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than security teams can react, urging organizations to rely more on automated defenses rather than manual investigations.

content:
吃盤乾炒牛河，找到善惡背後的理解──《善男信女》楊兩全的香港浮世繪 - 報導者 The Reporter
1992年生的香港電影導演楊兩全，以首部執導的劇情長片《善男信女》入圍第63屆金馬獎9項大獎。（攝影／鄭宇辰）
今年（2026）金馬獎最佳劇情片入圍的5部電影，其中2部出自新導演之手，由香港導演楊兩全執導的《善男信女》就是其一，總計入圍了9項大獎，儼然成為本屆金馬獎的香港代表。
《善男信女》從一個弱弱相殘的故事開始，進而描繪香港小人物的善與惡，並從中帶出人的複雜性。對於楊兩全而言，人性本善或本惡並不是最核心的提問，每個人都是善惡參雜，「選擇」朝向哪一邊才是重要的。
入圍第63屆金馬獎項：最佳劇情片、新導演（楊兩全）、男主角（楊偉倫）、女主角（鍾雪瑩）、女配角（彭秀慧）、原著劇本（楊兩全、火車）、造型設計（吳里璐、吳婉揚）、原創電影歌曲（〈世界好壞〉，詞 : 冬誠樟／曲 : 馮之行／唱 : Ian Hannz）、剪輯（李棟全）
星州炒米意外做成了乾炒牛河，兩位市井小人物就此展開了彼此報復的惡搞，弱弱相殘、誰是好人，誰又是壞人，而原來在那些善惡背後，有更大的一種失落與無力展開，香港這座吃人社會，善男信女們相恨相殺，最終能否抵達和解，在角落中看見另一道微光。
香港新銳導演，畢業於香港中文大學新聞與傳播學院，集導演、編劇等身分，編劇代表作品有《瀏陽河》、《野小子》，二度奪下短片競賽鮮浪潮大獎；導演代表作品有短片《白沙堆》，《善男信女》為其首部執導電影長片，入選多倫多影展同時入圍第63屆金馬獎最佳劇情長片、最佳新導演、最佳原著劇本等9項大獎。
在成為一名導演之前，楊兩全是先愛上文字與劇場的。就讀國中二年級時，他已經開始了文字創作，寫武俠小說，為什麼？因為金庸。《鹿鼎記》、《天龍八部》、《射鵰英雄傳》等每一本金庸小說，楊兩全都如數家珍，然後一頭栽進了文字創作的那片江湖。
高中時楊兩全開始讀純文學，新詩、散文也成了他著迷的體裁；高二走進了劇場，看了三谷幸喜的劇場《笑之大學》，就和兒時受金庸啟發相同， 墜入劇團世界、參加舞台劇工作坊，開始嘗試舞台劇的劇本創作，「我發現我的本質是喜歡講故事，那段時間就是嘗試不同類型，」楊兩全說。
到了大學原本想念中文系，但轉念一想，文字創作好像是一路以來的習慣，也早就在實踐寫作的路上了；但是，影像領域如果不去學，就沒辦法搞懂。因此，楊兩全進入了香港中文大學新聞與傳播學院，邊寫字、邊玩劇團、邊拍短片，也是在這個時期，楊兩全開始有意識地觀看電影。
然而，傳播學院的訓練，大多仍圍繞在新聞短片的處理，真正讓楊兩全拍成第一部劇情短片的起源，是因為台灣。
2014年，來到台灣交換的楊兩全參加「金甘蔗影展」，在屏東拍了人生第一支劇情短片；帶著「好玩」的體驗返回香港，畢業後進入影視產業。2026年，他帶著《善男信女》來台，個人也入圍了金馬獎最佳新導演、最佳編劇獎。（攝影／鄭宇辰）
大三那年，楊兩全來到台灣大學戲劇學系交換一年，偶然發現了以「現地拍攝、現地後製、現地影展」為核心，並鼓勵短片創作的金甘蔗影展。於是，楊兩全報名也入選，在屏東林邊拍成了人生第一支劇情短片。
楊兩全說：「那支劇情短片叫做《菲與飛》，也是我現在的工作室名稱，是與另一位導演黃嘉祺聯合執導的作品。金甘蔗影展的經歷很好玩，我們5天內就要拍出一支短片，第6天放映、第7天頒獎，這個影展確實在我的創作生涯扮演了一個很奇妙的角色。」
帶著金甘蔗影展以及台大戲劇系的歷程，楊兩全返回香港，畢業後進入影視產業，什麼職位都做，包含副導、場記、剪輯，當然還有他最熱衷的編劇工作。在那個階段，楊兩全也與另一名香港導演李駿碩聯合執導了短片《晚安》，直到2017年才獨立執導了短片《白沙堆》，首次獨自出手，就和數十年磨一劍的江湖隱士相同，獲得了鮮浪潮國際短片節最佳導演，技驚四座。
「不是謙虛，但就算拿了獎，我還是覺得當導演好難，要怎麼跟演員溝通、整合不同部門我都還是很生澀，我最喜歡也最有把握的就是做編劇，主要是我真的很喜歡文字創作，因為文字就只有自己和角色的對話，也是能獨立完成的工作，」楊兩全說。
後來，楊兩全暫停了導演身分，回到編劇工作，除了以編劇身分入選2022年金馬電影學院之外，這期間也持續替友人們寫劇本，包含《瀏陽河》、《野小子》、《過時・過節》等作。因為這樣，楊兩全持續觀察這些人是怎麼成為「導演」的，也很有機地替未來的導演工作鋪好了路。
回顧探索階段，楊兩全其實沒有任何一個瞬間，突然覺得一定要拍電影，「其實都是很自然長出來的，真要說的話，我認為自己是文學、劇場、電影的綜合體，就和當時我的筆名『何其美』一樣吧，「兩全」「其美」嘛，」楊兩全笑著總結。
電影《善男信女》裡，楊偉倫飾演的茶餐廳老闆鮑榮吉（左），和鍾雪瑩飾演的逐夢打工仔洪若蕾（右），發生了「怒嗆人生」式的衝突與相互報復，隱隱呼應著社會的創傷。（劇照提供／台北金馬影展執行委員會）
《善男信女》有句台詞，大致上是這麼說的：「一個劇本、故事，都是從一句話開始的。」至於楊兩全的這段旅程，則是從一個監視器畫面出發的。
「當時我在網路上外流的監視器畫面，看到某個菜檔中的大叔和賣菜大嬸打了起來，非常荒謬的畫面，但我就很好奇，為什麼這兩個人會突然吵架互毆，加上我當時有種狀態是，感覺這個世界很多事情很壞、很難，而我認為，這兩個人在生活中一定也有很多壓抑與累積，才會爆發；我就在想，也許透過這兩個人的故事，可以講出我的這些感受吧。」
在2010年至2020年期間，香港歷經了雨傘運動以及反送中運動，這兩次重要的社會運動與港府最後的決策，是從根本上讓香港歷經了秩序的崩塌、信仰的瓦解，政治上、生活上的無力感擴散，然後許多香港人離去了，這種社會氛圍瀰漫在後運動時期，可以說，運動創傷一直持續，始終沒有消散。《善男信女》的某些情節與藏於深處的情緒，似乎隱隱呼應這些衝突事件後的香港生活創傷。
「其實，我根本的出發點很簡單，就是想找到這兩個小人物背後的壓抑，於是就從他們的家庭、工作、朋友、愛情等面向去探索；而我也是不斷地將自己的生活狀態、經驗以及朋友的故事交融其中。後來我發現，送錯外賣、巴士過站不停這些不如意的事都只是表層，最底層的邏輯與情感還是──我覺得這個世上沒有什麼是公道的，天理好像也不存在了。」
《善男信女》是貼近楊兩全內在深處的故事，擁有了足夠厚實得以支撐一部長片的情感基底。於是，覺得當導演好難、數年沒當導演的楊兩全，這次說什麼也要自己執導，「不去拍就不會成長，而且，這個故事就算要死，也要死在我的手上啊！」
2023年，楊兩全開始了《善男信女》的劇本創作，並與自己非常信任的前輩監製莊麗真合作，共同報名「香港第八屆首部劇情電影計畫」，然後得獎了，於是開拍了。
雙雙入圍本屆金馬獎男女主角的楊偉倫（左後）、鍾雪瑩（右），是楊兩全心中的最佳人選，本質上都擁有一股喜感的演員魅力。（劇照提供／台北金馬影展執行委員會）
對於楊兩全來說，在往下挖掘角色背後的多重壓力，又或是想要找到兩個人為什麼打起來、又該如何繼續面對生活的答案時，在那之前，需要先去擁抱人的複雜性，避免角色的工具化與刻板化，如此才能讓觀眾看見這些真正的人，才具備說服力。
「這兩個人誰善、誰惡其實是很主觀的，而我在寫角色的時候，不是去想『這是好人』、『這是壞人』，我是都把他們當作『一個人』，並且不帶批判；我也並不想將主角設計成完美的受害者，雖然觀眾確實會因此更容易同情，但那是『假的』，人們都是不完美，這才會貼近我所相信的真實的人，才會有複雜性，這是最理想的狀態。」
而這樣的複雜性，除了劇本的設計之外，也需仰賴演員的演出，飾演主角的兩位演員楊偉倫、鍾雪瑩，是楊兩全心中的最佳人選，本質上都擁有一股喜感的演員魅力，幫了不擅於和演員溝通的楊兩全大忙。
當楊兩全完成劇本時，是立刻想到了楊偉倫，「他本身就很有生活感，很市井接地氣的，而且楊偉倫的樣子有點兇，但又因為比較矮小的關係，兇也兇不太出來，是符合角色的壓抑的；再加上，我也不想讓觀眾朝著對愛情的發展想像走去，楊偉倫好像就不會有這個問題。此外，楊偉倫演出的電影、劇場作品我也都很喜歡，最終他的演出跟我的想像也很接近，我們的互動非常順暢，完全符合我的期待。」
至於鍾雪瑩，就給了楊兩全意外的呈現。鍾雪瑩給出的表演能量，是比較冷調的，這與一開始的設定不太相同，「因為角色要對著幹啊，所以我原本認為這個角色的能量會再強一點，但鍾雪瑩認為這個角色是有一股疲憊感的，應該要再『冷』一點，會比直接爆發更好，我認為我也理解鍾雪瑩的做法了。確實，到了拍攝階段，除非真的是我無法理解的選擇，否則演員是比我更貼近角色的人，我會尊重演員，如果硬要演員接受我的想法，可能大家會更不自在。」
楊兩全是充滿彈性和有機性的導演，面對自己不擅長的「表演」就選擇相信「演員」，交給專業的決定；但是，也因為劇本夠好，演員非常清楚角色的心理狀態與歷程，多數時候都能照著劇本走向發展，這歸功於楊兩全的編劇能力，「楊偉倫和我說，不懂導戲也沒關係，因為我的劇本很完整了，他們都很喜歡，也很相信我。」《善男信女》的劇組，體現了導演、演員、編劇是相輔相成的關係。
楊兩全也特別提到配角彭秀慧、盧鎮業的重要性，尤其是自己在全力描寫主角的狀態時，容易忽略了配角的複雜性，就有可能落入「單一功能化」的窠臼。「彭秀慧、盧鎮業的角色，在劇本階段時都有種他們是偏向壞人的感覺，因為他們就是會傷害到主角們啊，那是很大的惡耶！但我非常感謝演員，他們在這種惡當中演出了一種我從未想過的複雜性，是參雜了一些愧疚。我才發現，原來壞人也是有罪惡感的，也讓我突然覺得這些角色很有意思耶！」
有趣的是，彭秀慧、盧鎮業兩個人都不覺得自己的角色是壞人。楊兩全認為，「他們是真正站在角色的立場去思考事情的，我的意思是，這世上沒有壞人會覺得自己是壞人，這樣才有複雜性，我們才能看見一些更深層的豐沛情感，而且從薄情演到深情，前後對比才會有立體度跟真實性，這種好壞參半的曖昧，真的是歸功於演員們，我覺得他們真的很好。」
《善男信女》最終，兩個弱弱相殘、彼此相殺的主角，有了相互映照的可能──從相恨到彼此慰藉，是楊兩全對於香港人、香港社會的善意與溫暖。（劇照提供／台北金馬影展執行委員會）
一部貼近現實生活的寫實電影，尤其又是有著相對深層且複雜的壓抑情緒，許多時候會看見的是一種苦情的「社會寫實電影」，而楊兩全卻是用一種「輕／黑色喜劇類型電影」去處理，這種無論是在上述的演員選擇，又或是劇本的編寫鋪陳以及剪輯混合類型片的方式，都是在一開始就定調了。
楊兩全說：「我一開始就知道這會是一部『輕／黑色喜劇類型電影』，但不是因為刻意，也不是取悅觀眾，而是這兩個人物彼此不爽、互相惡搞，本質上就會有一種荒謬感，我是跟著人物去開展戲劇以及決定類型的。其實，如果現在能重拍，片子前半段我會讓它再輕鬆一些，整體效果會更好。」
這種「輕／黑色喜劇類型電影」非常仰賴於剪輯節奏，楊兩全的初剪有兩個半小時，團隊所有人都看傻了，「怎麼那麼悶！」於是曾以《投名狀》、《狂徒》入圍金馬最佳剪輯，長期深耕於類型片創作的香港資深剪輯師李棟全出手，與楊兩全有共識地快刀剪去許多枝微末節，每場戲的對白也都有所刪除，力求加快節奏，最終，成了現在的模樣。
而這種凸顯「輕／黑色喜劇類型電影」的背後，楊兩全本質上拒絕提供所謂「毒雞湯」鴉片式的解方與快樂，同時不希望讓整部電影落入無盡哀傷，而也正因為剪接點的精準，得以體現劇本工整且細膩的雙線敘事。最終，兩個弱弱相殘、彼此相殺的主角，有了相互映照的可能──從相恨到彼此慰藉，是楊兩全對於香港人、香港社會的善意與溫暖。
「劇本創作到了中後段，我才發現這兩個角色有彼此理解的可能，理解的意思是──原來就算這個世界這麼難、這麼壞，但有人理解你的痛苦，然後共享那個痛苦，整個人就好像被淨化了，不爽的情感好像就能抒發了，就有一種溫暖，可以多活下去一點吧。對我來說，寫這個劇本，應該是找到了這個『理解的答案』，所以給了觀眾這些東西。」
楊兩全以片中的劇情解釋：「巴士過站不停的那場戲，來自我的自身經驗，表面上我是很生氣地打電話投訴，但內心深處是覺得，打電話有什麼用啊，這個世界又不會變。正當我這樣想，忽然發現有另一個陌生人也在打投訴電話，當時我們互看，然後笑了，應該就是被彼此療癒了吧。」
《善男信女》劇本創作到了中後段，楊兩全發現，同理、理解、相信，就是一股能支撐人在苦難裡活下去的力量。（攝影／鄭宇辰）
「這個世界又不會變」，讓人想到楊德昌《牯嶺街少年殺人事件》的台詞，以及最後刺入皮膚的那一刀；但是，如果這個世界不會變，或是這個世界很糟，那人們該如何活下去，又該相信什麼，才能在這個社會立足？對於楊兩全而言，除了「理解」之外，還有「相信」。
「我覺得，信仰就是讓人可以活下去的一回事；其實，即便拍完這部電影，你問我世界會不會變？我還是不知道，但是，我一定得選擇『相信』世界是會變的，要不然怎麼活下去？雖然很多事情，客觀來看好像是不會改變的，但是，如果所有人都相信有機會改變，會不會其實就有改變的可能了？所以，你騙也要騙自己相信這件事。」
這個相信與理解，是楊兩全想透過《善男信女》傳遞給所有觀眾的核心意義與答案，具體體現在片中的兩名主角──從一開始彼此的無法理解，最終發現有些苦痛和困境是相通的，然後就會在某個意想不到的瞬間，接住彼此，成為黑暗中的一點微光，就和結尾的那盤「乾炒牛河」一樣，吃飽了，就有力氣往下走了。
獨立的精神，是自由思想的條件。獨立的媒體，才能守護公共領域，讓自由的討論和真相浮現。

舒淇《女孩》裡貫穿全片的基隆中山陸橋，呼喚著侯孝賢《千禧曼波》；許承傑《雙囍》裡的圓山大飯店意象，令人聯想到楊德昌《一一》與李安《囍宴》。綜觀台灣新電影過去40餘年，是承先並同時啟後，無論其精神是反抗、冒險還是情義，仍在今年的金馬獎遍地開花。
「結一次婚、辦兩場婚禮，聽起來很荒唐，但我真的就辦了兩場婚禮。」許承傑的父母在他3歲的時候離婚，電影裡面童年的高庭生獨自一人搭飛機、往返在父母之間，時而掙扎、時而糾結的心境，很多就是導演自己的心路歷程。

美国国会预算办公室（CBO）：海军造船计划将需要大幅增加年度拨款 - Breaking Defense
未来企业号航空母舰 (CVN-80) 的船尾部分正在 HII 纽波特纽斯造船厂的干船坞内建造。 （贾斯汀·卡茨/突破防御）
华盛顿——根据国会预算办公室的一份新报告，与近年来平均造船拨款相比，海军 2027 年造船计划将需要大幅增加年度成本。
具体来说，国会预算办公室周四发布的报告称，5 月份发布的海军造船计划平均每年成本约为 538 亿美元，与过去 5 年海军每年约 38​​1 亿美元的拨款相比，总计增加了 41%。
CBO 表示，这一估算考虑了核动力舰艇加油、采购二手海运舰等非战斗力舰艇等成本，但这些成本并未纳入海军 2027 年造船计划，尽管此类费用通常来自造船资金。因此，与海军的造船计划相比，这些因素使国会预算办公室对海军平均每年造船成本的估计增加了约 46 亿美元。总而言之，这标志着造船支出达到了前所未有的水平。
报告称：“海军2027年造船计划的成本不仅与最近的资金相比很高，而且按照历史标准来看也很高。” “在过去的十年里，造船资金达到了自 2016 年里根政府 20 世纪 80 年代国防建设以来的最高水平。自 2016 年以来，立法者每年平均比总统要求的造船拨款多出 25 亿美元，部分原因是担心舰队太小而无法执行所有任务。”
如果仅考虑最近造船计划中购买的新船，CBO 估计这些船舶在 30 年内将达到 2026 年价值 1.47 万亿美元。报告称，这比海军估计的 30 年内 1.23 万亿美元有所增加。国会预算办公室将新船建造估算中的这些差异归因于“对某些未来船舶的设计和能力的假设”的差异。此外，国会预算办公室承认，它采用了不同的估算方法，并以与海军不同的方式解释了劳动力和材料成本的增长。
美国海军的造船计划和预算要求仅在 2027 财年就为造船项目筹集了总计 658 亿美元的资金。为了推进特朗普政府的黄金舰队计划，它呼吁到2031年将海军舰艇数量扩大到450艘，包括战力舰、辅助舰和无人舰。
美国国会预算办公室的报告称，“造船速度将是未来 10 年内最快的，反映出海军希望尽快扩大船队规模。” “从2030年代中期到2040年代中期，这一速度将会放缓；然后，建造活动将在2040年代末和2050年代再次加速，以取代在计划的第一个十年购买的使用寿命为20至25年的小型船舶。”

Navy’s shipbuilding plan would require massive hike in annual appropriations: CBO - Breaking Defense
Part of the aft of the future USS Enterprise (CVN-80) being constructed inside the dry dock at HII’s Newport News Shipbuilding. (Justin Katz/Breaking Defense)
WASHINGTON — The Navy’s 2027 shipbuilding plan would require a massive hike in annual costs in comparison to the average shipbuilding appropriations in recent years, according to a new report from the Congressional Budget Office.
Specifically, the Navy’s shipbuilding plan released in May would average out to an annual cost of roughly $53.8 billion — totaling a 41 percent increase from the roughly $38.1 billion the Navy has secured annually in appropriations during the last half decade, the CBO report released Thursday said.
This estimate factors in costs stemming from refueling nuclear-powered ships, and procuring non-battle force ships such as used sealift ships, among other things — costs that are not factored into the Navy’s 2027 shipbuilding plan, even though such expenses are typically derived from shipbuilding funding, CBO said. As a result, those factors increase the CBO’s estimate of the Navy’s average annual shipbuilding costs by roughly $4.6 billion in comparison to the Navy’s shipbuilding plan. Altogether, this marks an unprecedented level of spending for shipbuilding.
“The cost of the Navy’s 2027 shipbuilding plan is high not only compared with recent funding but also by historical standards,” the report said. “Over the past decade, funding for ship construction has reached its highest levels since the Reagan Administration’s defense buildup in the 1980s. Since 2016, lawmakers have generally appropriated an average of $2.5 billion more per year for shipbuilding than the President has requested, partly because of concerns that the fleet is too small to perform all its missions.”
Accounting for only purchasing new ships in the recent shipbuilding plan, CBO estimates those ships would rack up to $1.47 trillion in 2026 dollars over 30 years. That’s an increase from the Navy’s estimate of $1.23 trillion over 30 years, per the report. CBO attributed these differences in new ship construction estimates to differences in “assumptions about the design and capabilities of some future ships.” Additionally, CBO acknowledged that it employed different estimating methods and accounted for growth of labor and material costs differently than the Navy.
The Navy’s shipbuilding plan and budget request seeks a total of $65.8 billion for shipbuilding alone for FY27. To advance the Trump administration’s Golden Fleet initiative, it calls for expanding the Navy’s inventory to 450 ships, including battle force ships, auxiliary ships, and unmanned vessels, by 2031.
“The pace of shipbuilding would be fastest in the next 10 years, reflecting the service’s desire to increase the size of the fleet as quickly as feasible,” the CBO report said. “It would slow from the mid-2030s to the mid-2040s; then construction would ramp up again in the late 2040s and 2050s to replace smaller ships, with a service life of 20 to 25 years, purchased in the first decade of the plan.”

In total, Senate appropriators designated only $41.6 billion to shipbuilding in their proposed spending plan.

title: Autonomy firm Auterion to launch joint venture with Ukrainian drone maker Skyfall
zh_title: 自主公司 Auterion 将与乌克兰无人机制造商 Skyfall 成立合资企业
summary: 自主公司 Auterion 将与乌克兰无人机制造商 Skyfall - Breaking Defense 成立合资企业 乌克兰无人机制造商 Skyfall 于 2025 年 11 月 19 日在迪拜航展上展示其 Vampire 无人系统。（Daniel Woolfolk / Breaking Defense）华盛顿 — 美国自主软件公司 Auterion 和乌克兰无人机制造商 Skyfall 计划成立一家合资企业，“在位于乌克兰的一家新工厂为乌克兰大批量生产无人机”。德国，”Auterion 今天宣布。新公司名为《Skyfall X Auterion》，“是在‘Build with Ukraine’官方赞助下建立的”
content:
自动化公司 Auterion 将与乌克兰无人机制造商 Skyfall 成立合资企业
乌克兰无人机制造商 Skyfall 于 2025 年 11 月 19 日在迪拜航展上展示其 Vampire 无人机系统。（Daniel Woolfolk / Breaking Defense）
华盛顿——Auterion 今天宣布，美国自主软件公司 Auterion 和乌克兰无人机制造商 Skyfall 计划成立一家合资企业，“在德国的一家新工厂为乌克兰大批量生产无人机”。
公告称，这个名为“Skyfall X Auterion”的新企业“是在官方‘与乌克兰共建’国防合作框架的支持下建立的”。
Auterion表示，合资公司的“初期生产”将“集中于Shrike FPV平台”，预计随后将扩展到Skyfall拦截器以及中深度打击系统。该公司表示，“每架无人机都将 Skyfall 机身与 Auterion 航空电子设备以及 Auterion 操作系统结合在一起。”
Auterion 和 Skyfall 此前曾合作为乌克兰生产无人机，但 Auterion 今天表示，一家德国工厂“增加了空袭范围之外的生产能力，同时保持了 Skyfall 工程师可用的知识链接和较短的创新周期。
该公司表示：“前线部队的反馈每周都会到达工程师那里，并直接进入德国前线。”
总部位于慕尼黑和美国的 Auterion 表示，该协议是在今天的德国-乌克兰经济论坛期间签署的，路透社报道称，德国政府将为新工厂和无人机订单提供资金。该新闻专线援引一位行业官员的话说，资金将达到数亿欧元，首先向乌克兰提供无人机，然后向德国武装部队提供无人机。
Auterion 创始人兼首席执行官 Lorenz Meier 在公告中表示：“SkyFall 和 Auterion 已将超过 50,000 架无人机交付给乌克兰部队，这些无人机具有先进的终端制导和目标检测功能。” “德国的一家工厂为德国军队提供了乌克兰部队每周依赖的相同无人机的国内来源。”

Autonomy firm Auterion to launch joint venture with Ukrainian drone maker Skyfall - Breaking Defense
Ukrainian drone manufacturer Skyfall shows its Vampire unmanned system at the Dubai Airshow on Nov. 19, 2025. (Daniel Woolfolk / Breaking Defense)
WASHINGTON — American autonomous software firm Auterion and Ukrainian drone producer Skyfall plan to form a joint venture to “manufacture drones for Ukraine at high volume in a new factory in Germany,” Auterion announced today.
The new venture, called Skyfall X Auterion, “is being established under the auspices of the official ‘Build with Ukraine’ defense cooperation framework,” the announcement said.
According to Auterion, “initial production” by the joint venture will “focus on the Shrike FPV platform” and is expected to later expand to Skyfall interceptors as well as middle- and deep-strike systems. “Every drone combines a Skyfall airframe with Auterion avionics” as well as Auterion’s operating system, the company said.
Auterion and Skyfall previously partnered for drone production for Ukraine, but Auterion said today that a German factory in particular “adds production capacity outside the range of air strikes, while maintaining a knowledge link and short innovation cycle available to Skyfall’s engineers.
“Feedback from units at the front reaches those engineers every week and goes straight into the German line,” the company said.
Auterion, which is based in Munich as well as the US, said the agreement was inked during the German-Ukrainian Economic Forum today, and Reuters reported that the German government would provide funding for the new factory and for drone orders. Citing an industry official, the newswire reported the funding would be in the range of hundreds of millions of euros first to provide drones to Ukraine and then to the German armed forces.
“SkyFall and Auterion have put more than 50,000 drones into the hands of Ukrainian units with advanced terminal guidance and target detection” Lorenz Meier, founder and CEO of Auterion, said in the announcement. “A factory in Germany gives German forces a domestic source for the same drones Ukrainian units rely on every week.”

title: One data foundation and many application layers drive the Army’s NGC2 transformation
zh_title: 一个数据基础和多个应用层推动陆军 NGC2 转型
summary: 一个数据基础和多个应用层推动了陆军的 NGC2 转型 - 突破防御 美国陆军第 11 野战炮兵团第 25 步兵师炮兵团第 3 营士兵于 2026 年 2 月 20 日在夏威夷斯科菲尔德军营举行的“闪电浪涌 2”期间对 M777 榴弹炮进行了火力任务演练。士兵们正在测试一种新的工作流程，在该工作流程中接收火力任务通过下一代指挥和控制原型以数字方式在枪线上执行。这种由士兵主导的反馈正在帮助陆军开发更具杀伤力、更准确的未来能力
content:
一个数据基础和多个应用层推动陆军 NGC2 转型 - Breaking Defense
2026 年 2 月 20 日，第 25 步兵师炮兵第 11 野战炮兵团第 3 营的美国陆军士兵在夏威夷斯科菲尔德军营的“闪电涌动 2”期间对 M777 榴弹炮进行火力任务演练。士兵们正在测试一种新的工作流程，通过下一代指挥和控制原型机以数字方式接收的火力任务在枪前线执行。这种由士兵主导的反馈正在帮助陆军发展更具杀伤力、更准确和更有效的未来能力。 （美国陆军照片，海登·豪厄尔中校拍摄）（对私营行业人员或产品的描述或描述并不构成美国陆军或战争部的认可或宣传）
陆军的下一代指挥与控制 (NGC2) 工作基于一个简单的前提：陆军无法再承担无法相互通信、需要数年时间更新或在对手堵塞链接时失败的 C2 系统。从印太地区的行动来看，这些问题变得尤为明显。
陆军的答案是建立一个共享数据基础，将应用程序置于顶层，取代现在服务于火力、防空和后勤的单独的、特定于平台的系统。每个部件都经过精心设计，可以在保持与其余部件的互操作性的同时进行更换。
洛克希德·马丁公司项目、企业运营副总裁钱德拉·马歇尔 (Chandra Marshall) 表示，NGC2 的核心是“将范式转变为以任务为中心的运营”。她说，陆军希望建立一个具有通用应用程序和核心服务的可组合架构，从而能够集成新软件、武器和传感器，而无需返工并消除每个梯队的孤岛。
惩罚瘦腿的威胁图片
这种转变的例子始于电磁频谱。新美国安全中心国防项目研究员乔什·沃林指出，俄罗斯军队在乌克兰干扰、干扰和跟踪电磁频谱发射。他说，美国还没有遇到过如此严重地针对该频谱的敌人，而且陆军部队之间的通信和数据链接面临的风险随着印太地区强大的对手而增加。
然后是地理。沃林说，无论是全球反恐战争，还是当前的伊朗战争，甚至乌克兰战争，都没有要求陆军连接可能相距数千英里的系统。商业基础设施可以填补一些空白，尽管依赖蜂窝网络会更加困难。卫星通信可以提供另一种连接方式。
带宽可能是更严格的限制。陆军、海军和空军都在追求分布式作战概念，该概念假设分散的部队将不断在节点之间传递数据以保持同步。由于少数地点的兵力集结减少，这些数据必须通过更有争议的路径传输到更远的地方。
速度增加了压力，在乌克兰，“我们可能会讨论从获取到为目标提供服务的几分钟时间，”沃林说。
这个问题也存在于个别作战职能内部。在防空方面，直到最近，爱国者和萨德才能够通过萨德雷达控制爱国者拦截机相互提示。沃林认为，如果每个系统单独作战，分层防御就无法发挥作用。他说，这“效率极低”，而且相对于大型企业

【原文 English Original】
One data foundation and many application layers drive the Army’s NGC2 transformation - Breaking Defense
U.S. Army Soldiers with 3rd Battalion, 11th Field Artillery Regiment, 25th Infantry Division Artillery, conduct a fire mission rehearsal on an M777 howitzer during Lightning Surge 2 at Schofield Barracks, Hawaii, Feb. 20, 2026. The soldiers were testing a new workflow where fire missions, received digitally via the Next Generation Command and Control prototype, are executed at the gun line. This soldier-led feedback is helping the Army develop future capabilities that are more lethal, accurate, and effective. (U.S. Army photo by Lt. Col. Hayden Howell) (Depictions or descriptions of private industry personnel or products does not constitute endorsement or promotion by the U.S. Army or Department of War)
The Army’s Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) effort rests on a simple premise: the service can no longer afford C2 systems that can’t talk to one another, take years to update, or fail when an adversary jams a link. Those issues become particularly glaring when viewed in the light of operations across a theater as vast as the Indo-Pacific.
The Army’s answer is a shared data foundation with applications layered on top, replacing the separate, platform-specific systems that now serve fires, air defense, and logistics. Each piece is built so it can be swapped out while maintaining interoperability with the rest.
At its core, NGC2 is about “shifting the paradigm to a mission-centric operation,” said Chandra Marshall, vice president, programs, enterprise operations at Lockheed Martin. The Army wants a composable architecture with common applications and core services, she said, enabling integration of new software, weapons, and sensors without rework and knocking down silos at every echelon.
A threat picture that punishes stovepipes
The case for that shift starts with the electromagnetic spectrum. Josh Wallin, a defense program fellow at the Center for a New American Security, points to Ukraine, where Russian forces jam, interfere with, and track electromagnetic spectrum emissions. The US hasn’t faced an enemy that targets the spectrum so heavily, and the risk to communications and data links between Army forces grows against a capable adversary in the Indo-Pacific, he said.
Then there is geography. Neither the Global War on Terror, nor the current fight in Iran, nor even the war in Ukraine has required the Army to connect systems that might sit thousands of miles apart, Wallin said. Commercial infrastructure could fill some gaps, although relying on cellular networks would be more difficult. Satellite communications could offer another means of connectivity.
Bandwidth may prove the harder constraint. The Army, Navy, and Air Force are all pursuing distributed operating concepts, which assume scattered units will continually pass data among nodes to stay synchronized. With less massing of forces in a few locations, that data has to travel farther and over more contested paths.
Speed adds pressure, and in Ukraine, “we might be talking on the order of minutes from acquisition to servicing a target,” Wallin said.
The problem exists inside individual warfighting functions, too. For air defense, only recently have Patriot and THAAD been able to cue each other, with a THAAD radar controlling a Patriot interceptor. Layered defense can’t work if each system fights alone, Wallin argued. It’s “super inefficient,” he said, and against a large volume of incoming threats, stovepiped units may simply be unable to share information fast enough to coordinate a response.
Multinational partners pose for a photo after a counter-landing live-fire exercise as part of Exercise Balikatan 2026 at La Paz Sand Dunes, Laoag City, Philippines, May 4, 2026. (U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Duke Edwards)
The NGC2 data layer ingests information and makes it available to any application or operator according to role, access level, and warfighting function, Marshall explained. The Army sets the rules, and the system uses them to determine who needs a given piece of data and at what level of the force it should go.
This is a key challenge for NGC2 because air defense, logistics, and fires each run their own data and communications infrastructure. Centralizing data across them, according to Wallin, will give logisticians trying to sustain distributed forces visibility into ongoing operations, the threat picture, and intelligence feeds that once lived in separate systems.
Pooling the data is the first step. The next is drawing conclusions about how information across functions relate. The 25th Infantry Division in Hawaii has been the experimental unit charged with demonstrating the approach, with Lockheed Martin serving as the Full Stack Operational Implementation Lead.
During Lightning Surge 3 in April, the team fused sensors, fires systems, and airspace data into a single cloud-enabled picture, according to Marshall. She called it the first demonstration of cross-domain data sharing in the 25th ID environment, working across multiple locations that spanned Hawaii, the Philippines, and the broader Indo-Pacific. The outcome was a shared real-time view and compressed sensor-to-shooter timeline, she said.
The NGC2 program is also changing how the Army develops and fields C2 software. Rather than giving industry a fixed set of technical requirements, the Army established operational objectives that could be refined as soldiers used the systems. That has allowed developers to incorporate feedback directly from the field instead of waiting for the next major upgrade cycle.
“They give us feedback real time so we can make software changes within minutes, hours, days, depending on the complexity of the feature,” Marshall said. “When we conduct Lightning Surges, it’s about operational fight-tonight capability the 25th ID can use now. It’s not a prototype, so it’s been powerful in that regard.”
One example came during Lightning Surge 4, when soldiers wanted to operate the system without having to interact physically with a screen. Developers responded by integrating an AI-driven hand microphone with an Army edge device, allowing soldiers to issue spoken commands instead of touching. The capability was designed, built, and delivered within days, according to Marshall.
The approach represents a departure from programs in which requirements are established years before soldiers receive the resulting capabilities. Marshall said the team delivered NGC2 solutions in less than 10 months that the 25th ID used operationally across the Pacific and exercised during Balikatan, the annual US-Philippine military exercise.
AI as an aid, not a decider
Artificial intelligence (AI) is one of the applications layered on top of the data foundation, though both Marshall and Wallin were careful about how much weight to put on it. AI can comb through available data and turn it around to commanders quickly, cutting latency from minutes to seconds, according to Marshall. However, it is one tool among several, and it isn’t making decisions for the Army. It correlates data and offers recommendations so commanders have the right information at the right time. The decision aids already demonstrated are “very powerful,” she said.
The practical hope for AI, in Wallin’s view, is to automate what can be automated and speed up tasks that are heavily manual today. Even “a 60 percent solution on something that was 100 percent manual before” could free operators to focus on other responsibilities, he said.
Another important feature of NGC2 is that its architecture is designed so its layers can be pulled apart and replaced independently. The Army is trying to separate the physical data links, meaning which cable runs to which radio and which satellite, from the compute infrastructure, and to separate both from the software that manages the data, Wallin said. Soldiers interact with the application layers on top.
If an adversary finds a new way to jam or track something like a satellite terminal, the Army could replace that hardware with something less vulnerable without disturbing everything above it. Advances in computing power and the shrinking size of computing hardware could give the Army more room to accommodate future applications. More importantly, the service is moving away from the assumption that software and hardware acquired today must remain in service for decades.
The goal is to create an architecture that can continuously evolve as adversaries develop new methods of disrupting communications, targeting military networks, and exploiting vulnerabilities. Instead of replacing an entire C2 system, the Army could update individual components while preserving the larger data infrastructure.
Implementation of the Army’s Modular Open Systems Approach to NGC2 also makes it easier to move beyond specific suppliers and systems when they underperform or aren’t pacing evolving threats with improvements. At the 25th ID, Lockheed Martin runs what Marshall called a strict onboarding and offboarding process, evaluating each element with the Army to decide whether it is the right fit for its piece of the architecture.
That differs from traditional acquisition programs in which a single prime contractor may control much of the system and replacing a supplier can mean extensive integration work. By establishing common interfaces and services, the Army is attempting to make competition and continuous upgrades part of the architecture itself.
The ecosystem is already large. More than 60 companies have contributed to the Army’s NGC2 effort or are under analysis for it, Marshall said, including small businesses, nontraditional innovators, and commercial-technology providers. The 25th ID’s data platform is based on Raft’s Raft Data Platform. Amazon Web Services supplies Wickr Chat, a communications and collaboration tool. Rune Technologies delivered TyrOS for contested logistics.
For the Army, the larger test will be whether the approach demonstrated by the 25th ID can be extended to other formations without recreating the stovepipes NGC2 was designed to eliminate. The ongoing Lightning Surge exercises and the 4th Infantry Division’s Ivy Sting exercises at Fort Carson represent opportunities to evaluate how common data infrastructure, modular applications, and soldier-driven software development can support different operational requirements.
The stakes are particularly high in the Indo-Pacific, where formations will be separated by thousands of miles and forced to operate with intermittent comms. A shared architecture will not eliminate those constraints, but it could give commanders the ability to exploit available data, change communications equipment, and incorporate new capabilities without rebuilding the entire C2 network.
